title: Junior Key Account Manager – Renewable Energy Solutions
description:
Are you passionate about technical sales, building customer relationships and the future of renewable energy?

At Photomate, we are looking for a motivated and proactive Junior Key Account Manager to join our team in Denmark.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a technical mindset and commercial drive who wants to develop their sales career in the fast-growing renewable energy sector.

About Photomate

Photomate is an international renewable energy company specializing in solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), EV charging and smart energy solutions.

We support our business partners with innovative technologies, technical expertise and reliable service. As our business in Denmark continues to grow, we are looking for a new colleague to strengthen our commercial team.

Your Responsibilities

As a Junior Key Account Manager, you will work with both existing customers and new business opportunities in the Danish market.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Building and developing relationships with customers and business partners.

  • Identifying and approaching potential new B2B customers.

  • Participating in customer meetings and presenting our technical products and solutions.

  • Following up on quotations, sales opportunities and customer inquiries.

  • Working closely with our technical team to understand customer needs and identify suitable solutions.

  • Maintaining customer information and sales activities in our CRM system.

  • Supporting Photomate's business growth in Denmark.

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a commercially minded person who is genuinely interested in technology, enjoys understanding how technical solutions work and is motivated by developing customer relationships.

Ideally, you:

  • Have initial experience in technical B2B sales, account management or a customer-facing role within a technical industry, or have a relevant technical education combined with strong commercial motivation.

  • Have a genuine interest in technical products and enjoy learning how different solutions work.

  • Enjoy building relationships and actively approaching new customers.

  • Are structured, proactive and results-oriented.

  • Are curious, eager to learn and comfortable discussing technical topics with customers and colleagues.

  • Are fluent in both Danish and English, written and spoken (mandatory).

  • Are willing to travel within Denmark for customer meetings.

Experience in solar energy, battery storage, electrical distribution, EV charging, HVAC, industrial equipment or other technically driven B2B sectors is highly valued.

Direct experience in renewable energy is not essential, but a technical mindset and genuine enthusiasm for technology are key requirements. We are looking for someone who wants to understand the products they sell, not just sell them.

What We Offer

  • An exciting opportunity in a growing international renewable energy company.

  • Product training and support from experienced sales and technical colleagues.

  • The opportunity to develop your own customer portfolio and grow into a Key Account Management role.

  • Professional development and increasing responsibility.

  • An international and collaborative working environment.

  • The chance to contribute to the green energy transition.

Interested in Joining Us?

If you are commercially driven, technically curious and want to build your career in renewable energy sales, we would love to hear from you!

Location: Denmark – Copenhagen

Start date: By agreement

Apply: career@photomate.eu

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track). The positions are with the department's research groups located at the university campus in Copenhagen.

Your profile and work tasksWe seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.

The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

  • Cyber security
  • Privacy engineering
  • Computer Systems
  • Edge/cloud computing
  • High-Performance Computing (HPC)
  • Data Engineering
  • Big Data Infrastructure
  • Machine Learning Systems

The main tasks and responsibilities include:

  • developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.
  • providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.
  • participating in grant application activities
  • coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment

Your competenciesYou have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.

Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Who we areIn electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. 

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. 

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirementsAppointment as Assistant Professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

Tenure-trackWhen appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on:

  • The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
  • The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
  • The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
  • The candidate is a skilled communicator
  • The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
  • The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process

Evaluation and promotion proces:

  • Annual internal follow-ups to review progress on the promotion plan and ensure the assistant professor remains on track.
  • A mid-term evaluation, based on external review, conducted by an internal assessment committee after three years.
  • A final review by an external committee after 5.5 years. A positive outcome leads to a tenured appointment as Associate Professor.
  • Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship

Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorshipThe assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

  • Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
  • Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
  • Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
  • The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
  • The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 

If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.      Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: PhD Position in Large-Signal Modelling and Transient Stability Analysis of Wind Turbine Generators under Grid Fault Conditions
description:
The WindConnect (wind farm control and integration in sector-coupled power systems https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101227683) consortium unites leading experts from academia and industry across Europe, leveraging expertise in wind energy, power systems, power electronics, control engineering, artificial intelligence, and energy economics. This multidisciplinary collaboration addresses the pressing challenges of integrating wind energy into sector-coupled power systems including green hydrogen production, while ensuring grid stability, flexibility, and sustainability.

At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The PhD stipend is open for appointments from 1st March 2027 or soon after. The position is for 3 years, and it is funded by the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Networks programme under the WindConnect project.

  • On the date of recruitment (expected to be 1 March 2027), applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately preceding the recruitment date. Applicants must not hold a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment.
  • The project offers you competitive salaries (plus allowances) and funding for technical and personal skills training and participation in international research events.
  • You will participate in international secondments to other organisations in the network.

AAU Energy is a dynamic engineering research department in continuous growth and inspiring surroundings. AAU Energy has a very international environment and covers all areas of clean and sustainable energy systems of the future within electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technology. AAU Energy has campuses in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, this position is located in Aalborg.

The mission is to be world leading in both research and research-based education of the energy engineers of the future. AAU Energy has approx. 300 employees of many nationalities, of which 25 are administrative staff. In addition, AAU Energy constantly has approx. 50-70 guest researchers from around the world.

Research and teaching are in the absolute world elite in the field of energy, and we have extensive and leading workshop and laboratory facilities, where research and innovation are carried out in direct collaboration with industry to a great extent.

The position is offered in relation to the research program "Power Electronic Control Reliability and System Optimization" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems”.

The increasing integration of wind turbine generators significantly alters power system dynamics, particularly under grid fault conditions. While grid-forming (GFM) wind turbine generators contribute to voltage and frequency regulation, they may exhibit significant nonlinear large-signal behaviour during disturbances, including current limiting, control mode switching, and loss of synchronism. In multi-converter systems, these transient dynamics are further shaped by interactions among multiple GFM units and the surrounding grid strength. Conventional small-signal models are therefore inadequate, motivating large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis frameworks for GFM wind turbine generators under grid faults.

This poses the following key research questions:

  • How can large-signal models of GFM wind turbine generators be developed to accurately capture nonlinear dynamics, particularly current limiting and control mode transitions during grid faults?
  • How do multiple wind turbine generators interact during grid faults, and how do grid strength and system configurations influence their transient stability?
  • What are the dominant dynamic mechanisms governing transient stability, and how can reduced-order models be developed while preserving the essential nonlinear dynamics and stability characteristics?

This project will be in close collaboration with Ørsted. The PhD student is expected to work closely with colleagues from Ørsted and visit their facilities. The aim of this PhD project is to develop large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis methods for wind turbine generators under grid fault conditions, with particular emphasis on multi-inverter systems. The project seeks to identify key mechanisms affecting transient stability and to provide modelling and analysis tools that support robust control and protection design for future wind-dominated power systems.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (3-5 pages), which describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives. All documentation should be in English and merged in a single PDF document. Please note that applications which do not follow the announcement’s guidelines will not be considered.
  • Other relevant documents

Applicants should have an excellent academic background and hold a master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field. Knowledge or experience in power electronic converters and their control will be an advantage. Applicants who are in the final stage of their master’s studies are also encouraged to apply, provided that they complete their degree before the fellowship begins.

title: Engineer with Administrative Background and interested in Aviation.
description:
AIR ALSIE A/S is a Danish aviation company headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark. Our core business activities include flight operations, business aviation charter services and aircraft maintenance.

AIR ALSIE A/S is Scandinavia’s largest regional airline within the business aviation segment, and we are experiencing rapid growth and continuous development. As our organisation continues to expand, we are looking to strengthen our Technical Engineering team with a dedicated and skilled professional.

The Position

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Engineer or Aircraft Technician with a strong administrative mindset and an interest in aviation regulations and compliance.

The ideal candidate combines technical knowledge of aircraft maintenance with strong administrative skills and an understanding of regulatory requirements. You will play an important role in supporting and developing our technical organisation, ensuring that documentation, procedures and processes meet applicable aviation standards and regulatory requirements.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work across technical and administrative functions, collaborate with colleagues throughout the organisation and contribute to the continued development of AIR ALSIE A/S.

Are you passionate about aviation and motivated by being part of a dedicated team working towards shared goals? Do you want to take responsibility, make a difference and contribute to the future development of AIR ALSIE A/S? Then we would like to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage, maintain and update technical documentation and records in accordance with applicable aviation regulations and authority requirements.

  • Maintain and update the Maintenance Organisation Exposition (MOE), ensuring continued compliance with relevant regulatory requirements.

  • Establish and maintain effective communication and cooperation with aviation authorities.

  • Coordinate and collaborate with internal departments on matters relating to flight operations and aircraft maintenance.

  • Support the development and implementation of improvements to aircraft maintenance processes, procedures and working methods.

  • Assist in the planning and coordination of aircraft maintenance programmes and resource allocation.

  • Support the development and maintenance of employee training, competency and qualification programmes.

  • Contribute to ensuring a high standard of regulatory compliance and operational efficiency across the organisation.

Your Profile and Qualifications

We are looking for a structured and proactive individual who enjoys working with both technical matters and administrative tasks.

Ideally, you bring:

  • An educational background in aircraft engineering, aircraft maintenance or a related technical field, combined with administrative experience.

  • Experience with aircraft maintenance procedures, processes and practices.

  • Knowledge of aviation regulations, compliance requirements and industry standards.

  • Strong organisational skills and a structured approach to documentation and administrative tasks.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.

  • Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

  • The ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and maintain an overview in a dynamic working environment.

  • A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to handle challenges efficiently.

  • An aircraft maintenance licence, certification or other relevant professional qualifications will be considered an advantage.

What We Offer

At AIR ALSIE A/S, you will become part of an ambitious and growing aviation company where your contribution matters.

We offer:

  • An exciting position in a dynamic and developing aviation industry.

  • A varied role with a combination of technical, administrative and regulatory responsibilities.

  • Opportunities for professional development, further training and relevant certifications.

  • A collaborative and supportive working environment with highly skilled and dedicated colleagues.

  • The opportunity to influence processes and contribute to the continued development of our technical organisation.

  • Competitive salary and employment conditions in accordance with your qualifications.

A Great Place to Work

At AIR ALSIE A/S, we believe that our employees are our greatest asset. We offer an informal working environment characterised by mutual respect, strong teamwork and a high level of professional expertise.

We strive to create an inspiring workplace where employees are encouraged to take responsibility, share their knowledge and continuously develop their skills and talents.

Our continued growth and success are driven by the commitment, expertise and dedication of our employees. We believe in working together, supporting one another and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to make a difference.

Would you like to be part of our journey?

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague to the AIR ALSIE team!

Visit our website www.alsie.com to read more about our company.

Questions

If any questions, feel free to contact Maintenance Manager Torsten Plank Lorentzen TPL@alsie.com or by phone +45 74429888.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

If you recognise yourself in the profile described above and are motivated to take on the role of Engineer or Aircraft Technician at AIR ALSIE A/S, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Please submit your motivated application, CV and relevant educational certificates through our website at www.alsie.com.

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be conducted throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as we find the right candidate.

title: Head of Commercial Products
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
As Head of Commercial Products at Impact Fund Denmark, you will turn investment ideas and investor requirements into commercially viable funds and other investment products. You will build the financial models and fund structures that enable Impact Fund Denmark to attract additional private capital for investments in developing and emerging markets.

You will take responsibility for financial structuring and product development, combining hands-on modelling with a visible role in investor discussions. Working closely with the Head of Investor Relations, you will explain product economics, support fundraising and contribute technical expertise to the ongoing investor dialogue for existing funds.

The role is part of Legal, Compliance and Commercial (LCC), led by Frederik Bjørn, General Counsel & Chief Commercial Officer. LCC brings together Legal Corporate, Legal Transactions, Compliance (Non-Financial Risk), and Sales and Investor Relations and consists of around 15 colleagues across Copenhagen and IFDK’s international locations.

You will work in a highly collaborative environment, with close interaction across Investor Relations, Legal, Risk and the wider investment organisation. The team values openness, constructive challenge and strong professional collaboration. You will have considerable ownership of your area while drawing on specialist expertise from colleagues across LCC, Investment, Finance, Risk, Valuation and Strategy & Business Development.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design and structure investment products, including tranches with different risk and return profiles, risk-sharing arrangements and guarantees.

  • Build and challenge financial models using cash-flow analysis, scenarios and simulations, including Monte Carlo methods, to assess outcomes for investors and IFDK.

  • Assess how funds and products work together, including risk allocation and the implications of different investment and guarantee structures.

  • Develop fee and pricing models that reflect the economics of each product and the resources required to manage it.

  • Develop investor and sales materials and present products alongside the Head of Investor Relations, explaining structures, risks and returns and answering product-specific questions in investor due diligence.

  • Contribute financial analysis to information memoranda and ongoing investor reporting, and participate in Limited Partner Advisory Committee (LPAC) meetings and other investor fora for existing funds.

  • Work with Investment, Finance, Legal, Risk and Valuation colleagues to translate investor and guarantee requirements into clear responsibilities and processes throughout fund and product lifecycles.

YOUR FIRST YEAR

  • A consistent approach to financial modelling and clear investor materials supports product design, fundraising and ongoing investor dialogue.

  • Structuring and pricing options for priority products have been assessed, with clear recommendations on risk allocation and economics.

  • Responsibilities and handovers for key investor and guarantee requirements are agreed with the relevant teams.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You bring substantial experience in financial structuring and investment products, with the commercial judgement and credibility to take ownership and engage directly with institutional and other private investors. You have:

  • A relevant master’s degree in finance, economics or a related discipline with a strong quantitative foundation.

  • Experience personally building financial models and developing or structuring investment products.

  • A strong understanding of risk, return, cash flows and how financial structures allocate outcomes between different investors.

  • Experience working with institutional investors, supporting institutional clients or working on the investment side of a pension company.

  • Experience presenting complex financial topics to investors or institutional clients, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations and respond confidently to technical questions.

  • Strong written and spoken Danish and English.

You combine technical depth with commercial judgement, take ownership of detailed work and collaborate effectively across specialist functions. Experience with illiquid assets or private-market fund structures would be an advantage.

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

Based in Copenhagen, you will report directly to Frederik Bjørn, General Counsel & Chief Commercial Officer, and work closely with the Head of Investor Relations. You will have analytical support from Strategy & Business Development for product development and investor-related work.

WHY JOIN US

You will shape how IFDK combines institutional investor requirements, financial returns and impact. The role offers ownership of product development, direct exposure to investors and broad collaboration across IFDK, with the opportunity to see your work through from financial design to fundraising and ongoing investor reporting.

PRACTICAL DETAILS

Location: Copenhagen | Position: Full-time | Start date: By agreement

Please apply through IFDK’s recruitment platform with your CV and a short application explaining your interest in the role and relevant experience.

title: PhD in modelling and experiments on PEM electrolysis
description:
At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from January 1st or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks    The position is offered in relation to the research group "Hydrogen and Electro Fuels" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Thermal Engineering”.

Your competencies As a PhD student in modelling and experiments on PEM water electrolysis, you will work at the intersection of chemical and electrochemical reactor engineering, with a particular emphasis on electrolysis. The project focuses on testing proton exchange membrane electrolysis cells, characterising their electrochemical performance and developing detailed electrochemical cell models. You will design and carry out experiments on single cells, analyse electrochemical behaviour under different operating conditions and use the resulting data to build, calibrate and validate mechanistic models that describe transport, kinetics and degradation phenomena.

An important part of your work will be to investigate how PEM electrolysers perform when conventional materials are partially replaced by recycled ionomers and iridium. You will compare performance, stability and degradation patterns with and without recycled components and translate your findings into a deeper understanding of the underlying electrochemical mechanisms. In parallel, you will conduct techno‑economic assessments of PEM electrolysis systems, including related life cycle assessment studies, to evaluate how material choices, operating strategies and system design affect costs and environmental impacts over the full life cycle.

The PhD project is carried out in the context of the CYCLOPEM, EDSOES and CAPEX projects, which provide access to state‑of‑the‑art experimental facilities and collaboration with academic and industrial partners. You are expected to participate in project meetings and to present your results at international conferences and workshops. In addition, you will contribute to teaching activities within courses on chemical and electrochemical reactors and take part in the daily activities of the Hydrogen and Electro Fuels research group  at AAU Energy, including group meetings, seminars and joint publications.

The applicant must have a relevant professional and/or educational background within thermal, chemical and electrochemical engineering. Modelling of chemical and electrochemical reactor and LCA.Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

title: Pædagogisk medarbejder søges til Fonden Botilbuddet Hvidbjerghus.
description:
Pædagogisk medarbejder søges til Fonden Botilbuddet Hvidbjerghus.

Har du hjertet på rette sted, fagligheden i orden og måske et ekstra kram  i ærmet?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter til vores hold på Hvidbjerghus.

Hos Fonden Botilbuddet Hvidbjerghus søger vi pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere, som har lyst til at gøre en reel forskel for mennesker, der har brug for støtte, struktur og meningsfulde relationer i hverdagen.Vi søger ikke blot medarbejdere, der kan ”holde til noget”.Vi søger medarbejdere, der kan forstå noget.

Hos os er faglig robusthed evnen til at bevare nysgerrigheden, også når en borger reagerer voldsomt, trækker sig, bliver afvisende eller gør noget, der umiddelbart er svært at forstå. Vi søger mennesker, der kan være i kompleksiteten uden at ty til hurtige forklaringer eller hurtige løsninger.

Vi lover ikke, at alle dage er ens. Til gengæld lover vi, at ingen dage er ligegyldige.

Hvem er vi?

Hvidbjerghus er et døgnbemandet botilbud godkendt efter Servicelovens §107, §108 og §104. Vi tilbyder midlertidigt ophold til 15 voksne borgere over 18 år lettere udviklingshæmning, psykiatriske diagnoser og/eller forstyrrelser.

Vi er i dag fordelt på to afdelinger og har netop taget vores nye moderne modulhuse i brug, som skaber gode rammer for både borgere og medarbejdere.

Derudover driver vi §104-tilbuddet "Værket" i Hvidbjerg, hvor aktivitet, beskæftigelse og fællesskab går hånd i hånd.

Vores arbejde tager afsæt i KRAP og en tro på, at mennesker udvikler sig bedst gennem anerkendelse, relationer og meningsfulde fællesskaber. Vi møder borgerne med respekt, nysgerrighed og en grundlæggende overbevisning om, at alle gør det bedste, de kan.

Læs mere om os på www.hvidbjerghus.dk.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og store ambitioner.

  • Mulighed for efteruddannelse og faglig udvikling.

  • Stor indflydelse på den daglige praksis.

  • Frihed under ansvar.

  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

  • Fantastiske fysiske rammer med plads til både udvikling, aktiviteter og nærvær.

  • Et arbejde, hvor du mærker, at din indsats betyder noget.

Hvem er du?

·       Har erfaring, uddannelse eller interesse inden for det pædagogiske eller sundhedsfaglige område.

·       Kan skabe trygge og tillidsfulde relationer til mennesker, der til tider befinder sig i sårbare livssituationer.

·       Er fagligt nysgerrig og tør stille spørgsmål til egen praksis.

·       Kan bevare roen, når hverdagen bliver kompleks, uden at give slip på refleksionen.

·       Kan omsætte faglig viden til konkrete handlinger i mødet med borgeren.

·       Arbejder systematisk og kan dokumentere dine indsatser med blik for både kvalitet og udvikling.

·       Tager ansvar for dine beslutninger og kan begrunde dem fagligt.

·       Har kendskab til KRAP eller lyst til at lære metoden at kende.

·       Bidrager til et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at blive dygtigere.

·       Tror på, at mennesker udvikler sig bedst gennem relationer, anerkendelse og meningsfulde fællesskaber.

·       Ikke er bange for at give et kram, når det er det, situationen kalder på.

Praktiske informationer:

Stillingerne er på 30-37 timer ugentligt.

Arbejdstiderne er skiftende og kan være dag-, aften- eller nattevagter (sovende vagter). Der må påregnes arbejde gennemsnitligt hver tredje weekend.

Du vil kunne have vagter af forskellig længde og på tværs af vores to afdelinger.

Vi overholder naturligvis EU's hviletidsbestemmelser, hvilket betyder, at vagter som udgangspunkt maksimalt vil have en varighed på 13 timer.

Vil du vide mere?

Så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Faglig leder Lisbeth Laurberg 92 72 73 28

Administrativ leder Henrik Lægaard 24 46 34 25

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

Vi leder ikke efter den perfekte medarbejder. Vi leder efter mennesker med faglighed, engagement, humor og lysten til at gøre en forskel.

Hvis du kan se dig selv i det, så send os en ansøgning. Resten finder vi ud af sammen.

title: Distribution Van driver in Holbæk
description:

If you take pride in providing excellent customer service, enjoy working independently, and have experience in transportation and deliveries, we would love to hear from you.

As a Van Driver, you will play an important role in ensuring our customers receive their deliveries safely, professionally, and on time. You will be responsible for managing your daily route, handling goods carefully, and representing our company with a positive and professional attitude. You are also responsible for leading other employees in the company.

✅ A strong sense of responsibility, reliability, and professionalism

✅ The ability to remain calm and organised under pressure

✅ Good IT skills

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Stable employment with a growing company

  • A supportive and professional working environment

  • Independence and responsibility in your daily work

  • Opportunities to grow with the company as we continue to expand

title: Lastbilchauffør til fødevarevirksomhed / Truck driver for foodservice company
description:
Lastbilchauffør til fødevarevirksomhed.

Friske og energiske lastbilchauffør kollegaer søges hos fødevare virksomhed.

Vi er en fødevare virksomhed som søger medarbejdere med lyst til at levere stykgods til en bred vifte af restauratører på hele Sjælland.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst og søger hele tiden nye arbejdsområder og har derfor brug for flere dygtige lastbilchauffører, der kan indgå i teams med mange forskellige kolleger.

 

Lastbilchauffører til et mangfoldigt og sundt arbejdsmiljø

Som medarbejder hos os får du en tempofyldt hverdag med mange opgaver. Sammen med dine kolleger skal du sørge for, at leverancerne bliver udført på de aftalte tidspunkter.

 

Opgaver

-          når du møder ind, sikre dig at din lastvogn er pakket og klar til afgang

-          opsamle de nødvendige dokumenter til brug for leverancerne

-          levere stykgods til de aftalte kunder

-          andre ad. hoc lager-/ chaufføropgaver

Din udvikling i din stilling, samt muligheder for forbedringer er noget vi holder øje med, så vi hele tiden kan skabe et fælles og godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor orden, kvalitet og automatisering er i fokus.

 

Engagement & fleksibilitet

Du har muligvis erfaring med lager- eller logistikarbejde fra en tidligere stilling. Vi søger både kolleger med og uden truckcertifikat. Det er vigtigt, at du er fleksibel og trives godt med at arbejde i et dynamisk miljø, hvor vi lægger vægt på nøjagtighed og kvalitet.

Du er god til at prioritere og planlægge dine opgaver selvstændigt, og det falder dig lige så nemt at arbejde sammen med andre/et team om fælles at løse opgaverne. Fortrukne sprogkundskaber i prioriteret orden;

1. Tyrkisk          2. Kurdisk         3. Dansk            4. Engelsk

 

Løn

Løn aftales ifht. kvalifikationer. Som minimum aflønnes på baggrund af fælles overenskomst mellem DI Overenskomst II og 3F Fagligt Fælles Forbund, Transportgruppen - for lagerarbejdere, chauffører og havnearbejdere.

 

Krav

·         Du har et gyldigt kørekort C.

·         Du har allerede et gyldigt EU-bevis og førerkort eller vil opnå dette for at tiltræde stillingen.

Send din ansøgning og CV til job@megahouse.dk, markeret med ”Lastbilchauffør” i emnefeltet, så kontakter vi dig, hvis du opfylder kriterierne som kandidat til jobbet.

(ENG)

Truck driver for foodservice company

Fresh and energetic truck driver colleagues are wanted for a foodservice company.

We are a foodservice company who is seeking for employees who want to deliver bulk goods to a wide range of restaurateurs throughout Zealand.

We are a growing company and are constantly looking for new areas of work and therefore need more skilled truck drivers who can join the team with many different colleagues.

 

Truck drivers for a diverse and healthy working environment

As an employee with us, you will have a fast-paced everyday life with many tasks. Together with your colleagues, you must ensure that the deliveries are carried out at the agreed times.

 

Assignments

-          When you arrive, make sure your lorry is packed and ready for departure

-          Collect the necessary documents for use in the deliveries

-          Deliver piece goods to agreed customers/destinations

-          Other ad. hoc warehouse/driver tasks

Your development in your position, as well as opportunities for improvement, is something we keep an eye on, so that we can constantly create common and good working environment, where order, quality and automation are the focus.

 

Commitment & flexibility

You may have experience with warehouse or logistics work from a previous position. We are looking for colleagues with and without a truck certificate. It is important that you are flexible and enjoy working in a dynamic environment where we emphasize accuracy and quality.

You are good at prioritizing and planning your tasks independently, and it is just as easy for you to work together with others/a team to jointly solve the tasks.Preferred language skills in priority order;

1. Turkish          2. Kurdish         3. Danish          4. English

 

Salary

Salary is agreed according to qualifications. As a minimum, wages are paid on the basis of a joint agreement between DI Overenskomst II and 3F Fagligt Fælles Forbund, the transport group – for warehouse workers, drivers and port workers.

 

Requirements

·         You have a valid driving license C.

·         You already have a valid EU driving licence or will obtain this to fill the position.

Send your application and CV to job@megahouse.dk, marked with “Truck driver” in the subject field and we will contact you if meet the criteria as a candidate for the job.

title: Experienced VR Engineer for immersive training solution

title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Chief Flight Instructor - Denmark

About the Role

This position come with

  • Real decision-making authority over training quality and standards in a growing international organisation

  • A direct reporting line to the Head of Training and close ties to management

  • An established ATO with a clear, EASA-approved framework for the role

  • Access to a modern and growing fleet

  • An international working environment with colleagues and instructors from several countries

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • CPL(A) or ATPL(A)

  • Instructor certificate: FI(A)

  • Additional instructor certificates such as CRI(A) and IRI(A) are considered an advantage

  • A minimum of 1,000 hours as PIC, including at least 500 hours of instructional flying (industry practice is typically 1,500+ hours, and more experience counts in your favour)

  • Ideally, you also have experience leading, standardising or developing other instructors

  • Fluent English, spoken and written

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

  • Keep the vehicles clean and in good condition, inside and out.

Your profile:

  • You work independently, take responsibility and solve practical problems.

  • You can plan and organise your working day.

  • You are customer-focused and communicate professionally with customers and colleagues.

Desirable experience :

  • Experience with record-keeping and operational follow-up, such as using Excel to log completed tasks or track issues.

What we offer

A permanent, full-time position in a small team, with a mix of driving and practical vehicle maintenance and the opportunity to develop your mechanical skills.

How to apply

title: Assistant Head Chef
description:
Assistant Head Chef – Restaurant Gemma

Vil du stå i spidsen for den daglige drift i et køkken, hvor gastronomi, kvalitet og godt håndværk går hånd i hånd? Og motiveres du af at skabe mindeværdige madoplevelser, udvikle dine medarbejdere og sikre et højt gastronomisk niveau?

På Marienlyst Strandhotel søger vi en Assistant Head Chef til Restaurant Gemma, hvor du får en central rolle i den daglige køkkendrift. Du bliver en vigtig del af køkkenets ledelsesteam og får ansvaret for at drive dit eget hold med fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og en velfungerende hverdag.

Rollen

Som Assistant Head Chef i Gemma får du en central rolle i den daglige drift og udvikling af restauranten. Du er med til at sikre, at vores gæster får en helstøbt restaurantoplevelse, hvor gastronomi, præsentation og kvalitet går op i en højere enhed.

Du leder dit eget team og skaber rammerne for en struktureret og velfungerende hverdag. Det kræver, at du kan uddelegere ansvar, koordinere på tværs af funktioner og lede gennem andre, samtidig med at du selv er tæt på den daglige drift og det faglige håndværk.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med resten af køkkenets ledelsesteam, hvor I sammen sikrer en rød tråd i køkkenets drift, udvikling og gastronomiske ambitioner. I deler blandt andet ansvaret for oplæring og udvikling af vores kokkeelever og bidrager til at skabe et stærkt og sammenhængende køkkenteam.

Du refererer til vores Executive Head Chef.

Dine ansvarsområder

Du får ansvaret for at sikre en stabil og effektiv køkkendrift i Gemma med fokus på gastronomisk kvalitet, godt håndværk og en ensartet gæsteoplevelse.

Dine ansvarsområder omfatter blandt andet:

  • At lede, motivere og udvikle dit eget køkkenteam.

  • At sikre høj kvalitet og ensartethed i restaurantens gastronomiske leverancer.

  • At planlægge og koordinere den daglige produktion og service.

  • At sikre gode arbejdsgange, struktur og overblik i køkkenet.

  • At bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af restaurantens gastronomiske niveau og koncepter.

  • At sikre oplæring og udvikling af medarbejdere og kokkeelever.

  • At skabe et tæt samarbejde med resten af køkkenets ledelsesteam og restaurantens øvrige funktioner.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har solid erfaring fra en professionel køkkendrift, gerne fra hotel- eller restaurantbranchen.

  • Har ledererfaring og er vant til at stå i spidsen for medarbejdere og den daglige drift.

  • Er fagligt stærk og har en naturlig passion for gastronomi og det gode håndværk.

  • Har forståelse for, hvad der skal til for at skabe en stærk restaurantoplevelse.

  • Er en tydelig og nærværende leder, der formår at skabe struktur og engagement omkring sig.

  • Kan uddelegere ansvar og skabe resultater gennem andre.

  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for oplæring og udvikling af elever.

  • Er en stærk holdspiller, der prioriterer samarbejde og fælles ambitioner.

Vi tilbyder

En central lederrolle i Restaurant Gemma på Marienlyst Strandhotel, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på den daglige køkkendrift og være med til at udvikle restaurantens gastronomiske profil.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst køkken med høje faglige ambitioner og et engageret lederteam, hvor samarbejde, kvalitet og fælles ambitioner er afgørende for vores succes.

Klar til næste skridt?

Drop det klassiske ansøgningsbrev. Vi vil bare gerne høre, hvem du er.

Send os dit CV sammen med dine svar på to spørgsmål:

  • Hvad gør dig i stand til at lykkes i rollen?

  • Hvad motiverer dig til at søge jobbet?

Er du mere til video? Så optag gerne en kort præsentation, hvor du fortæller om dig selv og din motivation. Vi elsker at se ansigter og personlighed.

Spørgsmål?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Talent Acquisition:

Emil Stevnsemst@marienlyst.dk

Følg med i flere spændende muligheder

Vi har lanceret vores LinkedIn-gruppe, hvor du kan følge med i ledige stillinger, nyheder og hverdagen på vores hoteller og restauranter.

Du er meget velkommen til at blive en del af fællesskabet her:

https://www.linkedin.com/groups/10113247/

title: Restaurant Manager
description:
About Mr Bittu ApS

Mr Bittu ApS is an Indian restaurant based in Bagsværd, Denmark. We serve a variety of Indian street food, traditional dishes and curry specialities.

We are looking for a responsible, experienced and motivated person who can contribute to our kitchen operations and help manage the daily running of the restaurant.

About the position

We are seeking a "Restaurant Manager" to support food preparation, kitchen operations, staff coordination and the day-to-day management of the restaurant.

The successful candidate will work closely with the restaurant management to maintain food quality, service standards, hygiene and efficient daily operations.

Key responsibilities

Kitchen responsibilities

- Maintain consistency in food quality, taste and presentation.

- Monitor kitchen stock and assist with ordering ingredients.

- Maintain cleanliness and follow food safety and hygiene procedures.

- Organise kitchen tasks and coordinate daily food preparation.

Restaurant management responsibilities

- Assist with the daily operation and organisation of the restaurant.

- Coordinate kitchen and service staff during working shifts.

- Help organise staff schedules and daily work assignments.

- Monitor customer service and handle customer enquiries or complaints professionally.

- Support inventory control, stock management and supplier coordination.

- Monitor food costs, minimise waste and support efficient operations.

- Ensure that restaurant procedures and hygiene standards are followed.

Qualifications and experience

We expect the candidate to have:

- Previous experience in a restaurant kitchen and food preparation.

- Knowledge of Indian cuisine, including Indian street food and curry dishes.

- Understanding of kitchen hygiene, food safety and stock handling.

- Experience or ability to coordinate staff and organise daily restaurant operations.

- Good communication and teamwork skills.

- A responsible, organised and flexible approach to work.

- Ability to work independently and under pressure during busy periods.

Experience in both kitchen operations and restaurant supervision will be considered an advantage.

Language requirements

- Good English communication skills.

- Knowledge of Danish or other relevant languages is an advantage.

Working conditions

- Permanent employment.

- Full-time position.

- Work may include daytime, evening and weekend shifts according to the restaurant's opening hours and operational needs.

- Salary and employment terms will be agreed according to qualifications, experience and applicable Danish employment standards.

- Holiday and other employment conditions will be stated in the employment contract.

How to apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV and a short application explaining their relevant experience.

Apply by email: info@mrbittu.dk

Website: https://mrbittu.dk

Work location: Bagsværd Hovedgade 116M, 2880 Bagsværd, Denmark

We look forward to receiving applications from motivated candidates who would like to become part of our restaurant team.

title: Housekeeping Staff | Full-Time | Accommodation Available
description:
*** Right to Work in Denmark Required ***

Please read before applying.

Applicants must already have the legal right to work in Denmark.

Unfortunately, we are unable to assist with work permits or visa applications, and applications from candidates who do not have the legal right to work in Denmark will not be considered.

Join the Team at Ærø Hotel

Are you reliable, hardworking, experienced and looking for an opportunity to live and work in Denmark?

Ærø Hotel is currently looking for motivated employees to join our housekeeping team.

The positions primarily involve housekeeping, but the housekeeping team also assists with the hotel’s dishwashing department as part of the daily operation.

About Ærø Hotel

Ærø Hotel is a family-owned and family-operated hotel located in the maritime town of Marstal on the beautiful island of Ærø, Denmark.

The hotel has:

  • 100 hotel rooms

  • Around 35,000 overnight stays every year

  • Restaurant and Lounge Bar

  • Conference and event facilities

  • Indoor swimming pool

  • Fitness room

  • An international team with employees from several countries

Ærø Hotel is Denmark’s only adults-only hotel, welcoming guests aged 18 years and above.

English is the primary working language at the hotel, so it is not necessary to speak Danish.

Your Responsibilities

Your daily responsibilities will include:

  1. Cleaning and preparing guest rooms

  2. Cleaning bathrooms

  3. Changing bed linen and towels

  4. Making beds according to hotel standards

  5. Restocking guest amenities and supplies

  6. Cleaning corridors and other public areas

  7. Ensuring that all rooms are clean, tidy and ready for arriving guests

  8. Following the hotel’s cleaning procedures and quality standards

  9. Assisting in the hotel’s dishwashing department

  10. Washing dishes, glasses, cutlery and kitchen equipment

  11. Keeping the dishwashing area clean and organised

  12. Working closely with the rest of the housekeeping team to ensure an efficient daily operation

We Are Looking For People Who

  • Speak and understand English

  • Are reliable, responsible and hardworking

  • Have a positive attitude

  • Work well as part of a team

  • Are able to work independently

  • Are comfortable with physically demanding work

  • Can work efficiently while maintaining a high standard

  • Are flexible regarding working hours, including weekends

  • Preferably have previous experience from hotels, housekeeping or professional cleaning

Previous housekeeping experience is an advantage, but the right attitude, reliability and willingness to work are equally important.

What We Offer

  • Full-time employment

  • Start midle of january 2027

  • Hourly salary of DKK 130 before tax

  • 12.5% Danish holiday pay in addition to the hourly salary

  • Stable employment

  • Friendly and international colleagues

  • Thorough introduction and training

  • Staff accommodation available

  • The opportunity to live and work on the beautiful island of Ærø

Staff Accommodation

Staff accommodation is available approximately 10 minutes’ walk from the hotel.

At present, each employee has a private bedroom, while kitchen and bathroom facilities are shared with other employees.

Rent is DKK 750 per person per week, including:

  • Electricity

  • Water

  • Heating

  • Internet

During the coming winter, the staff accommodation will undergo a complete renovation. After the renovation, each room will have its own private bathroom and a small private kitchen, providing significantly improved and more independent living facilities for our employees.

Employment Details

Position: Housekeeping / Dishwashing

Salary: DKK 130 per hour + 12.5% Danish holiday pay

Working hours: Full-time

Start date: January 2027

Workplace:

Ærø HotelEgehovedvej 45960 MarstalDenmark

How to Apply

Please send your application by email to:

Nick HulegaardGeneral ManagerÆrø HotelNB@aeroehotel.dk

Please include:

  • CV

  • A short application or introduction about yourself

  • Recent photo

  • Relevant references, if available

  • Information about when you are available to start

Applications are reviewed continuously, and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.

The positions will be filled as soon as we have found the right candidates.

We look forward to hearing from you and hopefully welcoming you to the team at Ærø Hotel.

title: Paid Media Specialist – Social & Search
description:
Vil du være med til at drive Paid Media for et internationalt DTC-brand?

Vi elsker køkkengrej! Vi elsker kompromisløs kvalitet og produkter, der gør hverdagen i køkkenet nemmere. Men mest af alt elsker vi at give vores kunder følelsen af at Cook With Confidence.

Onyx Cookware™ er et dansk DTC-brand inden for premium køkkengrej med kunder på tværs af Europa. Vi sælger direkte til forbrugerne gennem vores egne webshops i 14 lande, med primært fokus på Danmark, Tyskland, Holland, Sverige og Norge.

Vi har ingen traditionel forhandlerkæde. Webshoppen er forretningen. Og derfor er vores digitale marketing en helt central del af den måde, vi skaber vækst på.

Paid Social er vores klart største fokusområde, men du skal være komfortabel med begge discipliner og forstå samspillet mellem dem.

Du får stort selvstændigt ansvar, korte beslutningsveje og mulighed for at påvirke, hvordan vi optimerer vores marketinginvesteringer og skaber resultater.

 

Om rollen

Som Paid Media Specialist får du det fulde operationelle ejerskab for vores betalte annoncering på tværs af Social og Search.

Du arbejder hands-on med kampagnerne og har ansvaret for opsætning, eksekvering, analyse og løbende optimering af vores indsats på tværs af markeder.

Du følger performance tæt og arbejder aktivt med blandt andet ROAS, CAC, omsætning, marketing spend, konvertering og kundeadfærd.

Men det handler ikke kun om at optimere kampagner og rapportere på resultater.

Du skal forstå, hvad der driver vores performance, identificere nye muligheder og omsætte data og indsigter til konkrete handlinger.

Du bliver samtidig en vigtig del af vores kommercielle kampagneeksekvering, hvor du i tæt samarbejde med de øvrige teams sikrer, at vores betalte kanaler er klar til lancering, og at kampagnerne løbende optimeres på baggrund af resultaterne.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med vores kreative afdeling om test, evaluering og skalering af creatives og budskaber, hvor dine performanceindsigter er med til at kvalificere den videre udvikling.

Du refererer til vores E-commerce Manager og samarbejder tæt med resten af vores kommercielle organisation.

 

Dine ansvarsområder

·         Eje og drive den daglige performance på Paid Social og Paid Search på tværs af 14 markeder, med størst fokus på Paid Social.

·         Opsætte, eksekvere og optimere kampagner i Meta Ads og Google Ads.

·         Sikre, at vores betalte kanaler er klar til kampagnelanceringer, og at eksekveringen sker i tæt samarbejde med de øvrige kommercielle teams.

·         Optimere vores marketinginvesteringer med fokus på omsætning, ROAS, CAC og profitabilitet.

·         Analysere performance på tværs af markeder, kampagner og målgrupper og omsætte indsigter til konkrete optimeringer.

·         Arbejde aktivt med budgetallokering og identificere muligheder for at forbedre afkastet af vores marketinginvesteringer.

·         Samarbejde med vores kreative afdeling om test, evaluering og skalering af creatives og budskaber.

·         Sikre løbende rapportering, opfølgning og konkrete anbefalinger til forbedring af performance.

·         Holde dig opdateret på udviklingen inden for Paid Social og Search og bringe nye muligheder og værktøjer i spil.

 

Vi forestiller os, at du

·         Har solid praktisk erfaring med performance marketing fra en e-commerce- eller DTC-forretning.

·         Du er stærk i Meta Ads og har samtidig god erfaring med Google Ads. Du er vant til selv at arbejde i platformene og ved, hvordan man bygger, optimerer og skalerer kampagner.

·         Du har en stærk analytisk og kommerciel forståelse og kan se sammenhængen mellem marketinginvesteringer, kundeadfærd, omsætning og profitabilitet.

·         Du arbejder struktureret med data, men du gemmer dig ikke i dashboards. Du kan omsætte analyser til handling og trives med at tage ansvar for dine egne resultater.

·         Du er nysgerrig, initiativrig og har lyst til løbende at teste nye muligheder og udfordre eksisterende måder at arbejde på.

·         Du trives med at arbejde på tværs af teams og forstår værdien af et tæt samarbejde mellem performance, kreativ udvikling og kommerciel eksekvering.

·         Erfaring med international e-commerce og annoncering på tværs af flere lande er en klar fordel – særligt hvis du har arbejdet med nogle af vores primære markeder.

·         Du motiveres af højt tempo, korte beslutningsveje og muligheden for at tage selvstændigt ansvar for dine områder

 

Hvad får du hos os?

Du får en central rolle i vores kommercielle team med fuldt operationelt ejerskab over dine kanaler og reel mulighed for at påvirke vores performance og vækst.

Du kommer ind i en international DTC-forretning, hvor Paid Media er en af vores vigtigste salgsdrivere, og hvor dine beslutninger har direkte betydning for forretningens resultater.

Vi investerer i vores brand, vores e-commerce-platform og den måde, vi arbejder med performance marketing på. Du får derfor mulighed for både at optimere vores eksisterende setup og være med til at udvikle den måde, vi arbejder med Paid Media fremadrettet.

Fra vores HQ i Sorø arbejder vi tæt sammen på tværs af e-commerce, marketing, content, produktudvikling og kundeservice. Det giver korte veje fra idé til handling og mulighed for hurtigt at teste nye initiativer.

Vi er en fleksibel arbejdsplads med mulighed for hjemmearbejde, hvor frihed under ansvar går hånd i hånd med et stærkt fællesskab.

 

Om Onyx Cookware™

Onyx Cookware™ er en international DTC-virksomhed, der på syv år har opbygget en stærk position med salg i 14 lande.

Vi er et dedikeret team på omkring 40 medarbejdere med base i Sorø. Vi har solide ejere i ryggen og klare ambitioner for den videre udvikling af Onyx Cookware™.

 

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Send os dit CV og en kort ansøgning, hvor du fortæller om din erfaring med Paid Social og Paid Search, og hvorfor du kunne se dig selv hos Onyx Cookware™.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

title: Head Chef for a New Italian Restaurant in Esbjerg
description:
Head Chef for a New Italian Restaurant in Esbjerg

We’re opening an Italian restaurant in Esbjerg and looking for a Head Chef to lead our kitchen team of six. You’ll join us before opening, with a chance to shape the menu, organise the kitchen and build a team that works well together.

We want to keep the menu small and give each dish the attention it deserves. You’ll develop a focused selection of Italian dishes that make the most of seasonal ingredients. Alongside it, you’ll work with our pizza chefs on a dedicated Neapolitan pizza menu.

Your responsibilities

  • Menu development. Create and test dishes, write recipes and help the team deliver consistent quality across every service.

  • Team leadership and rotas. Plan shifts for the six-person team, assign responsibilities and make time to train and support your chefs.

  • Daily service. Organise prep, cook alongside the team and keep service running smoothly when the restaurant is full.

  • Kitchen finances. Cost dishes and work closely with management to keep track of food costs, labour hours and waste.

  • Purchasing and food safety. Place orders, work with suppliers, manage stock and oversee food safety procedures.

About you

You have hands-on experience cooking Italian food and have led a kitchen team as a Head Chef or Sous Chef. You know how to turn an idea into a dish that tastes great, works during a busy service and meets its target food cost.

You give clear direction and lead by example. You notice when a colleague needs a hand, and you keep communication calm and respectful, even when the orders come in thick and fast.

What we offer

You’ll have a say in the first menu, how the kitchen is organised and how the team works together. You’ll work directly with management, with room to put your ideas into practice. Salary will reflect your experience and qualifications.

This is a full-time position with morning, lunch, evening and weekend shifts. The start date is flexible.

Interested in leading the kitchen? Apply through this listing with your CV and a few lines about your experience with Italian cooking and kitchen leadership.

title: Kontorleder
description:
Administration & Customer Service Coordinator

We are looking for a responsible, organised and service-minded Administration & Customer Service Coordinator in a transport company.

Our company operates a fleet of approximately five vehicles, providing transport services to private customers and business clients.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the company's daily administrative activities, transport documentation, customer communication and coordination with companies placing transport orders.

The position requires good organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to independently handle various administrative and customer-service tasks.

Key Responsibilities

Office Administration & Documentation

  • Handle daily office administration and general paperwork.

  • Prepare, maintain and organise transport documents, records and company files.

  • Maintain vehicle documentation, registrations, insurance records and other relevant paperwork.

  • Prepare administrative reports, schedules and correspondence.

  • Maintain organised records of company activities and transport operations.

Customer Service & Communication

  • Handle telephone calls, emails and enquiries from customers.

  • Respond to customer questions, complaints and service-related issues.

  • Maintain professional communication with business clients and companies ordering transport services.

  • Follow up on customer complaints, feedback and outstanding enquiries.

  • Ensure timely communication between customers, drivers and management.

Transport Administration & Coordination

  • Receive, register and follow up on transport orders from business clients.

  • Maintain records of bookings, completed trips, cancellations and changes.

  • Coordinate administrative communication between drivers and customers.

  • Follow up on transport assignments and report any operational issues to management.

  • Maintain driver and vehicle information and ensure that relevant documentation is up to date.

Invoicing & General Administration

  • Assist with preparing customer invoices and maintaining invoice documentation.

  • Organise supplier invoices, receipts and payment-related paperwork.

  • Maintain records of income, expenses and other administrative transactions.

  • Assist management with general administrative and reporting tasks.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience in office administration, customer service or coordination is preferred.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills.

  • Good English communication skills.

  • Basic computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office.

  • Good organisational and documentation skills.

  • Ability to handle customer enquiries and complaints professionally.

  • Ability to manage multiple administrative tasks independently.

  • Responsible, reliable and detail-oriented approach to work.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

We Offer

  • Full-time employment of 37 hours per week.

  • Fixed monthly salary according to qualifications and experience.

  • A professional and friendly working environment.

  • An opportunity to take responsibility for the company's daily administrative and customer-service activities.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Administrations- og kundeservicekoordinator

Vi søger en ansvarsbevidst, struktureret og serviceminded administrations- og kundeservicekoordinator til en transportvirksomhed.

Virksomheden driver cirka fem køretøjer og leverer transportydelser til både private kunder og erhvervskunder.

Den rette kandidat får ansvaret for at varetage virksomhedens daglige administrative opgaver, transportdokumentation, kundekommunikation samt koordinering med virksomheder, der bestiller transportydelser.

Stillingen kræver gode organisatoriske evner, sans for detaljer og evnen til selvstændigt at håndtere forskellige administrative opgaver og kundeserviceopgaver.

Arbejdsopgaver og ansvarsområder

Kontoradministration og dokumenthåndtering

  • Varetage den daglige kontoradministration og almindelige administrative opgaver.

  • Udarbejde, vedligeholde og organisere transportdokumenter, registre og virksomhedsmapper.

  • Vedligeholde dokumentation vedrørende køretøjer, herunder registrering, forsikringer og øvrige relevante papirer.

  • Udarbejde administrative rapporter, oversigter, planer og korrespondance.

  • Sikre systematisk registrering af virksomhedens aktiviteter og transportopgaver.

Kundeservice og kommunikation

  • Besvare telefonopkald, e-mails og henvendelser fra kunder.

  • Håndtere kundeforespørgsler, klager og spørgsmål vedrørende virksomhedens ydelser.

  • Opretholde professionel kommunikation med erhvervskunder og virksomheder, der bestiller transportydelser.

  • Følge op på kundehenvendelser, klager, feedback og udestående spørgsmål.

  • Sikre rettidig kommunikation mellem kunder, chauffører og ledelsen.

Transportadministration og koordinering

  • Modtage, registrere og følge op på transportbestillinger fra erhvervskunder.

  • Vedligeholde oversigter over bookinger, gennemførte kørsler, aflysninger og ændringer.

  • Koordinere den administrative kommunikation mellem chauffører og kunder.

  • Følge op på transportopgaver og rapportere eventuelle driftsmæssige problemer til ledelsen.

  • Vedligeholde oplysninger om chauffører og køretøjer samt sikre, at relevant dokumentation er opdateret.

Fakturering og generel administration

  • Medvirke til udarbejdelse af kundefakturaer og vedligeholdelse af tilhørende fakturadokumentation.

  • Organisere leverandørfakturaer, kvitteringer og betalingsrelaterede bilag.

  • Vedligeholde registreringer af indtægter, udgifter og øvrige administrative transaktioner.

  • Bistå ledelsen med generelle administrative opgaver og rapportering.

Kvalifikationer og krav

  • Relevant erfaring inden for kontoradministration, kundeservice eller koordinering er en fordel.

  • Gode mundtlige og skriftlige kommunikationsevner.

  • Gode engelskkundskaber, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

  • Grundlæggende IT-færdigheder og kendskab til Microsoft Office.

  • Gode organisatoriske evner og sans for dokumentation og detaljer.

  • Evne til at håndtere kundehenvendelser og klager på en professionel måde.

  • Evne til selvstændigt at håndtere flere administrative opgaver samtidigt.

  • Ansvarsbevidst, pålidelig og struktureret tilgang til arbejdet.

  • Evne til både at arbejde selvstændigt og indgå i et team.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fuldtidsansættelse på 37 timer om ugen.

  • Fast månedsløn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

  • Et professionelt og imødekommende arbejdsmiljø.

  • Mulighed for at få ansvar for virksomhedens daglige administrative opgaver og kundeservice.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning!

title: Employees wanted (Dough department and other tasks)
description:
Mamma Production A/S is a semi-industrial bakery located in Farum (north of Copenhagen) looking for motivated employees for our production team. Together with Casa Italia A/S – which exclusively handles sales and commercial activities – we form a solid family business, where Mamma Production handles the entire production.

Your primary tasks (dough department):

Cleaning and tidying up in your own work area in accordance with applicable hygiene regulations.

title: Full-Time Pizza Chef – New Italian Restaurant in Esbjerg
description:
Full-Time Pizza Chef – New Italian Restaurant in Esbjerg

We’re opening an Italian restaurant in Esbjerg with a dedicated Neapolitan pizza menu. We’re looking for an experienced pizza chef to take charge of the pizza station, from mixing the dough and preparing the toppings to baking pizzas for both dine-in and takeaway.

What you’ll do

  • Make the dough. Mix, portion and ball the dough, and manage fermentation so each batch is ready for service.

  • Prepare the station. Make sauces, prep toppings and plan quantities with the Head Chef based on expected orders.

  • Run pizza service. Stretch each base by hand, top and bake the pizzas, and coordinate dine-in and takeaway orders with the rest of the kitchen.

  • Help shape the menu. Work with the Head Chef to test recipes and develop the pizza selection before opening.

About you

You have hands-on experience making Neapolitan pizza and feel confident managing dough from mixing to baking. You can read the dough, judge when it’s ready to stretch and keep an eye on the bake when several orders come in at once.

You enjoy running your own station and working closely with the kitchen team. Joining before opening means you’ll have a say in how the pizza station is set up and how service runs.

Location: Esbjerg · Position: Full-time · Start date: Flexible

Interested? Apply through this listing with your CV and a few lines about your experience making Neapolitan pizza.

  • Evne til at hjælpe aktivt i køkkenet under travle serveringer.

Send ansøgning og CV via Jobnet eller til restaurantens kontaktadresse.

description:

Derudover vil du hjælpe med pluk og pak, klargøring af varer samt oprydning og andre forefaldende opgaver.

  • Lettere mekanisk montage og samling af tekniske komponenter

  • Pluk og pak af varer og komponenter

  • Klargøring og håndtering af materialer

  • Kvalitetskontrol af eget arbejde

  • Oprydning og sikring af orden på arbejdspladsen
