contract-based).•    ERP / financial systems proficiency (e.g. Oracle ERP), including the ability to improve and optimise system-based settlement workflows.•    Process automation & digitalisation: description: The Census Field Support Officer (previously known as Census Enumerator) is a key member of the Census 2027 field staff team. The Census Field Support Officer job is 18 hours per week (mainly evenings and weekends) and is an eight-week contract from 5 April to 28 May. The rate of pay for the full duration will be over €3,000 plus an allowance. Candidates must be over 18 years of age.

description: We at Trinity Community Care Clg (formerly known as Ballymun Home Help Service Ltd and Marino Fairview Home Care Service) are a registered Charity and were established to provide support in the community of North Dublin over 40 years ago.   We are currently recruiting  Health Care Assistants in Dublin 3, 11 and 9 (North Dublin). Key Responsibilities:Assisting clients with daily living activities such as bathing, dressing, grooming, and toiletingPreparing and serving meals and snacksLight housekeeping dutiesAssisting clients with mobility and transfersProviding companionship and emotional support to clientsRequirements:Minimum of 6 months experience in a Health Care Assistant RoleFull Award in QQI Level 5 in Healthcare  or working towards minimum requirement  Care Skills and Care of The Older Person Full driving license and access to a car is desirable but not essential or living locally Excellent communication and interpersonal skillsAbility to work independently and as part of a teamEligible to Work In Ireland Flexibility to work various shifts including evenings and weekends

title: Assistant Pharmacy Manager
description: Assistant Pharmacy Manager, Tonlegee road40 hours per weekOur people make the difference. Here at PHX Ireland, we strive to be a place for everyone - where each and every one of us can be our true, authentic selves, every single day.  For us, individuality sparks new ideas, shapes new approaches and brings us powerful new perspectives. It’s the heartbeat of our innovation, creativity, and success. Which is why, at PHX Ireland, we don’t just embrace our differences – we celebrate them.  Across United Drug, McCabes Pharmacy, and TCP Homecare, in every location and every role, the way we work makes us who we are – and that’s something we are really proud of. Which is why we’ve summed up our ethos in our six PHX Ireland values; Customer focused, Quality driven, collaborative, ambitious, innovative, and inclusive. We currently have an exciting opportunity for an Assistant Pharmacy Manager to join our team. Why work for McCabes Pharmacy? We believe if you succeed, we succeed and together we grow. When you join our team, you will get all the support you need to thrive and be successful. Our Benefits Include: • Private Health Contribution.  • Assistant Manager Bonus.  • Maternity pay and paternity pay benefit.  • Generous staff discounts in-store • Sick Pay • Employee Assistance Programme.  The main duties of this role will include the following: • In conjunction with the Pharmacy Manager ensure that pharmacy targets are achieved. • In conjunction with Pharmacy Manager ensure that care targets are achieved.  • Oversee allocations.  • Project management of Company initiatives. • Seek new business opportunities by examining the local markets and competitor activities.  • Management of deadlines including regarding policies and procedures. • Management of TMS, the Pharmacy Manager still has overall responsibility for TMS.  • Address customer complaints and escalate as appropriate to the Pharmacy Manager. • Report and provide information to the support office as required. • Any other projects and duties where they arise.  The behaviours we seek and encourage: • A strong business acumen. • Excellent retail knowledge.  • Experience of successfully managing and leading people.  • Excellent interpersonal and influencing skills.  • Ability to understand, calculate and manage budgets and targets.  • Ability to plan to reach set targets.  • Proven experience in maximizing performance and developing people.  • Proven ability to think analytically and strategically.  Essential Criteria • A least one-year retail management experience  About McCabes Pharmacy McCabes Pharmacy is one of Ireland's most loved Pharmacy providers, pioneering truly innovative services over the past 40 years. We are founded on values of compassionate care, advice you can trust, speedy service and excellent value for money. The patient and customer are truly at the heart of what we do. The teams that serve our customers are central to our organisation. Our commitment to our staff is to enable them to develop their careers and to have as many opportunities to be the best they can be. We support our team with continuing education, great working conditions, flexibility and good incentives and benefits and a fun loving working environment. If you think you could flourish along side us, please apply.   About PHX Ireland & PHOENIX Group    PHX Ireland Group is Ireland’s leading fully integrated healthcare provider. We deliver health. We are comprised of United Drug, Ireland’s leading pharmaceutical wholesaler and distributor; McCabes Pharmacy, Ireland’s leading community pharmacy chain; and TCP Homecare, innovators in clinical home nursing services and direct to patient delivery solutions. PHX Ireland Group employs over 1,800 people, operates 5 distribution centres and pharmacies nationwide, delivering over 85 million packs to Irish pharmacies and hospitals and serving 500,000 patients each year. By working together to provide these solutions, PHX Ireland can enable a sustainable healthcare system and support Irish Healthcare. PHX Ireland is part of the PHOENIX group, Europe’s leading healthcare provider. Headquartered in Mannheim, Germany, the PHOENIX group brings together more than 48,000 employees from 29 countries, includes 223 pharmaceutical distribution sites, and more than 3200 owned pharmacies and 17000 partner pharmacies. Every day, the PHOENIX group makes an important contribution to comprehensive and safe healthcare in Europe. We strive to foster an open and inclusive environment, embracing applications from individuals of all backgrounds. Our commitment lies in ensuring an accessible interview process for all candidates. If you require additional support or accommodations to attend an interview, we kindly encourage you to reach out to jobs@mccabespharmacy.ie

title: Carpenter
description: Timothy Bowen, based in Mahon, Cork, is looking for two full-time carpenters to join our construction team. Each role is to support the team in delivering quality carpentry work on site, under the supervision of experienced carpenters. Duties include measuring, cutting and fitting timber and other materials as directed, helping with framing, doors, skirting, flooring and general first and second fix work, using hand and power tools safely and keeping them in good condition, following site health and safety rules at all times, and keeping the work area clean and tidy. Previous experience is not essential and full training is provided, but candidates should have basic knowledge of manual and power tools, a willingness to learn, good English and a team-player attitude. Each job is 39 hours per week, paid at €18.05 per hour (€36,605 per year), and work is carried out on construction sites in Cork City and surrounding areas.

title: Pipe Welders - Breffni Air (Ireland) Unlimited Company
description: Breffni Air (Ireland) Unlimited Company requires 4 Pipe Welders for full-time work in The Green, Kilnaleck, Co Cavan, A82 ER25.The successful candidates will be responsible for the welding, pre-fabrication and assembly of pipework systems in a workshop environment, in accordance with engineering drawings, technical specifications and relevant quality and safety standards.Main Duties and Responsibilities:- Weld, fabricate and assemble pipework systems.- Prepare, cut, align and weld pipes and fittings.- Read and follow engineering drawings and specifications.- Inspect welds to ensure quality standards.- Work on own initiative and as part of a team.- Meet daily targets.- Perform physical duties, including lifting and prolonged standing.- Follow company health and safety procedures.Other Details: - Hours: Standard working week of 39 hours- Annual Salary: €36,605-€41,000 per annumTraining in English language skills, company operating procedures will be provided.Applications: Please send your application to the following email address: gsrecruitmentjobs@gmail.com

title: Heavy Goods Vehicle (HGV) Mechanics
description: Job Title: Heavy Goods Vehicle (HGV) MechanicEmployer: Garahys Garage LimitedLocation: Fortal, Birr, Co. Offaly R42 N277Hours: 40 hours per weekAnnual Salary: €37,544-€40,000 per annum.Number of Positions: 8Aureol Global Connections is hiring for Heavy Goods Vehicle (HGV) Mechanics on behalf of Garahys Garage Limited Fortal, Birr, Co. Offaly R42 N277, Ireland. The ideal candidate will have experience in maintaining, servicing and repairing trucks, buses and vans within a busy commercial vehicle repair centre, with mechanical and diagnostic skills. A Level 6 Craft Certificate in Heavy Vehicle Mechanics (or equivalent) and at least two years’ post-qualification experience are required. The role will also involve carrying out Commercial Vehicle Tests on light and heavy commercial vehicles, with training provided for candidates who are not already qualified as CVRT Testers. The successful candidate will be reliable, safety-conscious, detail-oriented and capable of working effectively in a busy team environment. This is a full-time role of 40 hours per week with an annual salary range of €37544-€40000. Interested applicants should send their CV to info@aureolglobalconnections.com.

title: Chef de Partie
description: Murfind Ltd is seeking a Chef de Partie to join the team at Padraicin's, Furbo Hill, Furbo, Co. Galway, Ireland, H91 YW68. Candidates must have at least two years’ experience in a similar role within a busy kitchen. Duties include working across all kitchen sections, including the grill, fryer and pastry sections, and occasionally assisting at the pass. The successful candidate will be required to prepare, cook and serve food to a consistently high standard and maintain a clean and tidy workspace. Candidates must be punctual, energetic and able to learn quickly in a fast-paced environment. Salary: €36,605 per annum. Hours: 39 per week. To apply, please send your CV to Seamus at padraicins@gmail.com

title: Healthcare Assistant (Laois)
description: The best disability organisation to grow your careerResilience Healthcare is one of Ireland's fastest-growing disability service providers. title: Residential Care Worker
description: Are you passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of children? Do you thrive in a dynamic and supportive work environment? We have the perfect opportunity for you! Join our team at Ashdale Care (Ireland), on our journey to transform the lives of young people with complex, emotional and behavioural needs.No two days are the same here in Ashdale Care, this job description is designed to be flexible and adaptable, providing guiding principles for the work rather than strict limitations. It will undergo periodic review to ensure alignment with evolving organisational needs.  You will be part of a unique team who will work together to facilitate excellent practice and be part of rebuilding children’s lives. Our vision is for every young person who lives with us to experience a safe, happy and nurturing present and a future that is filled with hope and optimism.    Cultivate genuine and caring connections with the young people, always interact with the young people and their families with dignity and respect, promoting a culture of unconditional positive regard.    Contribute to the promotion, creation, and maintenance of a welcoming, safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment.    Advocate for the rights and responsibilities of each young person while promoting physical, emotional, social, cultural, ethnic, and spiritual wellbeing.    Ensure that young people are not subjected to any forms of abuse and report any concerns according to policy and procedures.    Supervise outings from the home and undertake daily household activities such as cooking and cleaning, as part of positive modelling.    Actively participate in working within the Model of Therapeutic Care.    Be physically able to support with challenging behaviours when needed.    Provide emotional support during difficult or stressful times and encourage young people's participation in care planning, placement planning, decision-making and service delivery.    Integrate understanding of youth trauma and past experiences into practice through specialised training such as Developmental Trauma and Attachment from the Therapeutic Support Team.    Collaborate with support networks, including social workers and educators, guardians and family members.    Collaborate effectively within a team, engaging in regular communication through daily handovers, team meetings, and various reviews and planning sessions. Give and receive feedback on performance with colleagues and managers.    Maintain consistency in execution of childcare plans.    Complete and maintain accurate records and reports for each young person in line with statutory requirements and Ashdale Care policies and procedures.    Take on key worker duties including the handling of daily petty cash, accurately documenting receipts, securely storing money and valuable items and serving as a primary point of contact for professionals/family/young person.

title: Retail Software Quality Assurance Engineer
description: •    Establish and maintain a centralised software-testing framework covering the retail systems used across all three stores, including test plans, scripts, acceptance criteria and documented results.•    Test POS and SumUp transaction workflows, including grocery and deli sales, card payments, refunds, discounts, promotional offers, voids and end-of-day reconciliation.•    Validate the consistent operation of centrally maintained product records, barcodes, prices and approved VAT settings across store systems, including the distribution of changes from central operations to each location.•    Test grocery and convenience retail pricing functionality, including multi-buy offers, promotional periods, reduced-price products and store-specific pricing where applicable.•    Test deli sales functionality, including product variants, meal deals, weighed products and configured hot-food and cold-food tax treatments, where supported by the systems.•    Validate inventory software workflows for supplier deliveries, goods receipts, purchase orders, supplier returns, inter-store transfers and stock adjustments, ensuring accurate updates to both store-level and central records.•    Test system functionality for recording perishable stock, expiry dates, wastage and deli ingredient consumption, where these features are implemented.•    Perform integration and end-to-end testing between POS, SumUp, ERP, inventory and central databases, identifying missing, duplicated, delayed or incorrectly processed transactions.•    Validate SSIS data-integration packages used to consolidate information from the three stores, including data transformations, scheduled processing, error handling and recovery from failed loads.•    Test Power BI dashboards and SSRS reports covering store sales, product performance, stock movements, wastage, margins and payment reconciliation, checking calculations against underlying source data.•    Test revenue reporting integrations and financial data exports, verifying that sales, refunds and configured tax amounts are accurately transferred to the relevant accounting and reporting systems.•    Manage and maintain company-controlled retail and reporting databases, including SQL queries, views, stored procedures, scheduled jobs and data structures, within authorised access arrangements.•    Monitor database performance, data integrity, access permissions and backup processes, coordinating recovery testing and technical maintenance with the company’s IT providers.•    Develop automated software tests and data-validation checks to verify transaction accuracy, integration reliability and consistency between the three stores and central operations.•    Record and investigate software defects, database discrepancies and integration failures, working with system vendors and developers to resolve issues and verify corrective changes.•    Coordinate user-acceptance testing with grocery, deli and store-management personnel, assessing whether system changes meet operational requirements before deployment.•    Conduct regression testing before centrally managed software updates, pricing-system changes and integration releases are introduced across the stores.•    Maintain test evidence, database procedures, integration documentation and software-quality reports, providing central management with clear findings and release-readiness recommendations.

title: addetto alla pianificazione acquisti/addetta alla pianificazione acquisti
description: We are partnering with a prominent industry-leading client to find a STRATEGIC BUYER with a primary focus on steel and metal components. Location: Italy (with frequent interaction across the Group's operations in Italy -Padova and Imperia- and Germany) The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing sourcing strategies for key direct material categories, with a primary focus on steel and metal components, followed by electric motors, plastics and fasteners. This is a highly visible role with a significant impact on the Group's profitability through cost reduction initiatives, supplier development, volume aggregation and strategic sourcing projects across our Italian and German operations. Key Responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Category Management - Develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned commodity categories. - Manage RFQs, tenders and supplier negotiations at both local and international levels. - Analyze commodity markets, industry trends and key cost drivers. - Build and maintain a robust pipeline of cost-saving initiatives. - Drive supplier competitiveness while ensuring quality and supply continuity. Group Synergies & Volume Leverage - Identify opportunities to aggregate purchasing volumes across Group companies. - Negotiate framework agreements, volume rebates, index-based pricing mechanisms and commercial terms. - Lead supplier consolidation and standardization initiatives. - Support make-or-buy decisions, localization projects and low-cost-country sourcing strategies. - Harmonize supplier terms, payment conditions and Incoterms across the Group where appropriate. Supplier Development & Management - Develop strategic relationships with key suppliers. - Lead supplier scouting, qualification and onboarding activities. - Identify and implement alternative sourcing solutions to reduce supply chain risks. - Manage supplier performance and continuous improvement programs. - Collaborate closely with Quality, Engineering, Operations and Finance teams. Cost Optimization & Value Engineering - Partner with Engineering and Operations on: o Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VA/VE) o Product standardization o Specification optimization o Target costing initiatives o Localization projects - Challenge supplier quotations through market benchmarking and should-cost analysis. - Drive sustainable cost reduction and productivity initiatives. Reporting & Performance Monitoring - Track spend, savings and procurement KPIs. - Develop and maintain procurement dashboards using Excel and Power BI. - Report sourcing activities, savings projects and supply risks to senior management. - Ensure appropriate contract coverage and procurement governance. What We Are Looking For Essential Requirements - Minimum 7/10 years of experience in strategic procurement of direct materials within a manufacturing environment. - Strong experience in: o Steel purchasing o Metal fabrication sourcing o Commodity management - Proven track record in international procurement and global sourcing. - Solid understanding of: o Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) o Cost breakdown analysis o Incoterms o Contract negotiation o Cross-border supply risks - Fluent English and Italian both written and spoken. - Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI or similar analytical tools. Preferred Qualifications - Experience sourcing electric motors, gear motors, plastics or industrial components. - Previous experience working in multinational and multi-site industrial organizations. Key Competencies Strategic Negotiation You understand supplier economics, create competitive tension and secure long-term commercial value through effective negotiations. Analytical Mindset You leverage spend analysis, cost models, market intelligence and data-driven decision making to identify opportunities and support strategic initiatives. Category Management You can build and execute sourcing strategies, supplier roadmaps and multi-year savings plans. Collaboration & Influence You effectively engage stakeholders across Procurement, Engineering, Operations, Quality and Finance, driving alignment across multiple sites and countries. Results Orientation You are passionate about delivering measurable savings, improving procurement performance and creating business value. What We Offer - A strategic role with high visibility within an international industrial group. - The opportunity to influence procurement strategy and business performance at a Group level. - Exposure to international sourcing projects and cross-functional initiatives. - A dynamic and collaborative work environment. - Opportunities for professional growth and career development. - Full remote working - Salary range: 70-80K Euro - Benefits: company Car - Availability to travel approximately 60% of working time, including regular visits to suppliers and frequent travel to the Group's sites in Padua, Imperia and Horstmar, with travel frequency varying according to business needs and project requirements. Capacità di pianificazione, gestione priorità, avanzamento lavori e controllo economico. Disponibilità a trasferte sui cantieri (Italia settentrionale) Leadership 'sul campo', attenzione a regole, sicurezza e metodi di lavoro. Ottime doti relazionali: comunicazione chiara, negoziazione e problem solving. Affidabilità, pragmatismo e forte orientamento a tempi e consegne. description: GI GROUP SPA, prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, per un'importante realtà industriale internazionale operante nel settore della produzione di apparecchiature ad alta tecnologia, ricerca un: Analista Chimico ICP OES/ICP MS Responsabilità: Sviluppo metodi e validazione: sviluppare procedure analitiche per metalli (composizione bulk e tracce) con OES/XRF, combustione ed estrazione a caldo; e per metalli in soluzione dopo digestione con ICP-OES/ICP-MS. title: Principal System Applications Engineer Solid State Transformer  (SST) (f/m/div) (Ingenieur/in - Mikroelektronik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. Turning customer whispers into industry-shaking solutions... ready to amplify the future?As a Principal System Applications Engineer Solid State Transformer (SST) on our Customer Collaboration and Technical Marketing team work hand-in-hand with our customers, enabling them to transform our products into cutting-edge designs, all while building long-lasting partnerships that thrive on success.Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Engage with leading customers to understand SST architectures, requirements, and technical challenges, translating them into semiconductor and subsystem solutions.- Develop and validate application solutions through simulation, prototyping, measurements, benchmarking, and troubleshooting.- Create technical proof points using PoCs, demonstrators, and experimental validation, including collaboration with external partners.- Convert engineering results into customer-ready technical materials, such as design recommendations, BOM guidance, simulation models, and training content. - Enable Field Application Engineers (FAEs) and regional teams through technical training, workshops, and support for complex customer engagements.- Support strategic customer projects and design-ins, working with customers and internal experts to solve system-level application challenges.Your profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field, combined with 6+ years of industry experience in power electronics, power conversion, or application engineering.- Possess strong expertise in power converter topologies and power semiconductor technologies, with experience in Solid-State Transformers (SSTs), medium-voltage systems, modular converters, or multilevel converters considered a plus.- Demonstrate a broad system-level understanding of gate driving, control, protection, sensing, magnetics, thermal management, and reliability.- Apply hands-on experience in simulation, hardware development, commissioning, measurement, and troubleshooting to develop and validate engineering solutions.- Translate system requirements into practical semiconductor and subsystem recommendations, balancing technical performance and application needs.- Thrive in global, cross-functional environments, showing strong ownership, collaboration, and the ability to influence and drive topics independently across regions, divisions, customers, and external partners.Salary pay information:AustriaAt Infineon in Villach you shape the technologies of tomorrow and work in an international environment with more than 4.700 colleagues from over 70 nations. Your personal contribution will be valued and appreciated as the cornerstones of our success. And all that in beautiful surroundings which guarantee a high quality of life.The City of Villach is located in the center of Carinthia, Austria’s southernmost province, in close proximity to the Italian and Slovenian border. Due to its particular geographic location and the outstanding natural beauty of the region, Villach and the whole province of Carinthia have for generations been popular holiday destinations for people from all over the world. Living in Austria also has many social, health-care-related and economic perks. The country’s social and health care system is among the best in the world and for decades numerous international surveys have singled out Austria as a particularly safe and wealthy country with a high quality of life. Villach benefits from its status as a “small town”, offering everyday living at affordable prices in an outstanding setting.We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group I,J* (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.ItalyLocationIndicative salary rangeMilan, Italy*€63360 – €87120*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. title: Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) - HRC1792713 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Driving continuous improvement - ready to make quality a culture?As a Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) in our Quality & Excellence team uncover the root causes behind every single error, drive transformational improvements, and implement forward-thinking solutions to ensure our products exceed the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Act as the technical lead and methodological expert for Burn-in (BI), including steering BI decisions, driving continuous improvements, and serving as the primary interface to technology and product development as well as statistics teams- Provide teaching, coaching, and knowledge transfer on Burn-in topics to cross-functional teams, ensuring a consistent and high-quality understanding of BI methodologies across the organization- Support Design for Stress (DfS) sustaining activities, including the management and resolution of DfS Jira Tickets in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders- Serve as the 1st level of support for internal customer inquiries, with a particular focus on** Automotive Governance**, ensuring timely and solution-oriented responses- Drive long-term, strategically important tasks that require sustained attention, ensuring that critical but non-urgent topics receive appropriate prioritization and follow-through- Collaborate closely with Front-End (FE), Back-End (BE) and product development teams, contributing expert knowledge on failure mechanisms, defects, design and test conditions to support informed quality decisions- Lead customer communications about early topics- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), processes, methods, and tools along the entire supply chain, with a strong automotive quality mindsetYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field- At least 6 years of professional work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality management along the supply chain, Front-End and Back-End processes, and reliability testing- Expert-level knowledge in Burn-in methodologies, including deep understanding of physical failure mechanisms, defect analysis, Fault Analysis (FA), and test conditions relevant to semiconductor devices- Proven experience as a technical lead in a cross-functional environment, with the ability to drive decisions, align stakeholders, and manage Design for Stress (DfS) activities effectively- Solid understanding of wafer manufacturing process, foundational skills in data analysis, and familiarity with chip design, test engineering and product development processes- Proficiency in digital collaboration tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Intranet platforms- Show a strong automotive quality mindset and knowledge about automotive requirements- Outstanding interpersonal skills and a genuine service provider attitude, with demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and inspire colleagues while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture- Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plusPlease send us your CV in EnglishPlease note that:- Subject to meeting all job requirements, belonging to protected categories under Law 68/69 will be considered a preferential requirementAdditional information by locationAustriaWe offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H,I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.Salary pay information:In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.LocationIndicative salary rangePadova, Italy*€52,000 – €71,500*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/)  and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/)  at Infineon.HRC1792713

title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante azienda cliente ricerchiamo: Buying Planner La risorsa, inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Buying e in collaborazione con i Buyer e la Direzione Commerciale, supporterà le attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio e gestione operativa degli ordini, contribuendo all'ottimizzazione della disponibilità del prodotto, della rotazione delle scorte e della marginalità. Nello specifico, la figura inserita si occuperà di: Monitorare le performance di vendita dei prodotti, analizzando sell-in, sell-out, stock, rotazioni, stock coverage e marginalità per categoria, brand, linea e punto vendita, individuando trend, criticità e opportunità commerciali; Supportare la pianificazione degli assortimenti e dei fabbisogni di prodotto per insegna, categoria, stagione e canale distributivo, sulla base dei dati storici, previsionali e degli obiettivi commerciali; Supportare il team Buying nella definizione dei quantitativi di acquisto e nella costruzione dell'assortimento; Monitorare il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ingresso in assortimento fino alla fase di fine stagione, individuando eventuali criticità e opportunità di intervento; Analizzare le giacenze e individuare tempestivamente situazioni di overstock, understock e slow moving, supportando la definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Supportare il team Buying, in collaborazione con Planning & Allocation, nell'individuazione delle esigenze di riassortimento e redistribuzione del prodotto; Monitorare l'andamento dei budget di acquisto e degli obiettivi economici assegnati alle diverse categorie merceologiche, segnalando eventuali scostamenti; Gestire operativamente l'inserimento, l'emissione e l'aggiornamento degli ordini di acquisto a sistema, assicurando la correttezza delle informazioni relative a prodotti, quantità, prezzi e condizioni concordate; Monitorare l'avanzamento degli ordini, verificando conferme d'ordine, variazioni, cancellazioni ed eventuali anomalie e interfacciandosi con i fornitori per gli aspetti operativi; Presidiare il follow-up delle consegne e il rispetto delle tempistiche previste, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali ritardi o scostamenti rispetto alla pianificazione e garantendo l'allineamento tra piano di acquisto, ordini emessi e merce in consegna; Predisporre e mantenere aggiornata la reportistica relativa a ordini, budget impegnato, consegne, stock e performance di prodotto, fornendo analisi a supporto dell'Ufficio Buying e della Direzione Commerciale. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in discipline economiche, statistiche, gestionali, moda o affini. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di Buying Planning, Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising o Product Management, preferibilmente nel settore fashion retail. Conoscenza delle logiche di assortimento, pianificazione e gestione dello stock nel settore retail. Spiccata capacità di analisi e interpretazione dei dati. Utilizzo avanzato di Excel; gradita la conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo: approccio analitico e commerciale, capacità di lettura delle performance di prodotto, ottime capacità organizzative e di pianificazione, precisione, problem solving, Sede di lavoro: Palermo, Orari: Lun-Ven 8:30 - 13:00 / 14:30 - 18:00 CCNL Commercio Range Retributivo previsto: € 23.300 - € 27.000. Il posizionamento all'interno della fascia sarà determinato sulla base delle competenze e dell'esperienza professionale coerenti con i requisiti della posizione. *Grafton Office è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut.Min. 26/11/2004 PROT. 1101 - SG). title: ingegnere meccanico
description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. How can you support us? supporting the maintenance engineering lead in reviewing the project technical documentation in respect to the contractual requirements, gathering of maintenance related design data from technical disciplines and vendors to build-up a comprehensive plant asset register which includes all the maintainable equipment, preparation of Maintainable Equipment List (MEL) hierarchically organized by functional location which in turn refer to physical asset; operability and maintainability review, support mechanical handling assessment, equipment criticality analysis (ECA) to rank item listed in MEL in view of safety, environment and production requirement, maintenance strategies, procedures, and tasks according to either the original equipment manufacturer data or the results of the performed Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis; operational performance standard preparation; CMMS loading templates preparation Education: Master's Degree/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar qualification Experience: 5+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry Languages: English level B2/C1 What else should you know? Some travelling will be expected within EMEA, Africa, etc What we can offer to you: Permanent Contract, CCNL Energia e Petrolio For home office contract: Pay not lower than 43000€ Corporate Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, internal gym, discounts and partnerships, services related to health, family, well-being, and in-house cafeteria. title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description: We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a3D Production Manager (m/f/d)Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, StockholmYOUR TASKS:- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters- Actively contributing to the further development of our companyYOUR PROFILE:- Experience in leadership- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness- Fluent English (business level)OUR TOP 3 REASONS:- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design- Responsibility right from the start- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international companyAfter an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.-------------------Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen3D Production Manager (m/w/d)Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, StockholmDEINE AUFGABEN:Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter WorkflowsAufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in HanoiÜberwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von ProzessenOrganisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen ZentraleAktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres UnternehmensDEIN PROFIL:FührungserfahrungErfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-WorkflowsErfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von VorteilFreude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter KommunikationHohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie ZuverlässigkeitStrukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte ArbeitsweiseHohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und DurchsetzungsstärkeFließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte UnternehmenskulturVerantwortung von Anfang anKurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen UnternehmenNach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

title: To stipendiatstillingar ved European University Institute (EUI) i Firenze
employer: UNIVERSITETET I BERGEN DET HUMANISTISKE FAKULTET
description:
Stipendiat

Det er ledig to stipendiatstillingar (100%) ved European University Institute (EUI) i Firenze. Oppstart i stillingane i september 2027. Stillingane er ledig for ein periode på tre (3) år, med moglegheit for stipend for eit fjerde år. 

Stillingane er finansierte av det norske kunnskapsdepartementet. Stipendiatane vert teken opp i eit av ph.d.-programma ved EUI, med Universitetet i Bergen som arbeidsgjevar.

Om EUI og ph.d.-programma

European University Institute er eit europeisk forskingsuniversitet innan humaniora og samfunnsvitskap som ligg i Firenze i Italia. EUI har ph.d.-program innan historie, økonomi, samfunnsvitskap og rettsvitskap. Stipendiatane knytt til ph.d.-programma kjem frå 25 ulike europeiske land. Gruppa med stipendiatar er organisert i kull, med samtidig oppstart kvar haust. 

Søkjarane som får tilbod om stipendiatstilling, får opptak til eitt av dei fire ph.d.-programma. 

Ph.d.-utdanninga er normert til fire år.

Meir informasjon om EUI, programma og søknadsskjema finn du her: Doctoral Programmes

Kvalifikasjonar og krav:
  • Søkjaren må vere norsk statsborgar eller ha permanent opphaldsløyve i Noreg.
  • Søkjaren må ha mastergrad eller tilsvarande grad. 
  • Søkjarar som har fullført doktorgrad, kan ikkje bli tilsette i stipendiatstilling innan det same fagområdet.
  • Det er EUI som vurderer om fagbakgrunnen til dei som søkjer opptak er relevant for det einskilde ph.d.-program.
Løn og andre vilkår:
  • Løn som stipendiat, som for tida svarar til ei brutto årsløn på NOK 593.700.
  • Etableringsstipend det første året etter satsane til forskingsrådet: NOK 300 000 for enkeltperson og NOK 516 000 ved familie
  • Driftsmidlar: NOK 50 000 pr år
  • Stipend det fjerde året. Opptak til det fjerde året må stipendiaten søkja EUI om. Ved innvilga opptak vert det gjeve stipend frå EUI og UiB.
Slik søkjer du stillinga:

Lenke til EUI sitt søknadsskjema finn du her: Doctoral Programmes.

Informasjon om faglege krav i søknaden, innhald i programmet og arbeidskvardagen kan ein få ved å sjå på «FAQs and Contacts» under det einskilde program. 

Generell informasjon:

Informasjon om arbeidsforholdet til UiB og UiB si forvaltning av avtalen kan ein få ved å kontakte: 

Seniorrådgiver Yngve Brynjulfsen, yngve.brynjulfsen@uib.no, 

+47 55 58 33 82 

    

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Universitetet i Bergen er ein anerkjend utdannings- og forskingsinstitusjon, organisert i sju fakultet og omlag 54 institutt og faglege senter. Campus ligg i sentrale delar av Bergen med universitetsområde på Nygårdshøyden, Haukeland, Marineholmen, Møllendalsveien og Årstad.

Det humanistiske fakultet består av fire institutt og fire senter. Les meir om fakultet og tilhøyrande institutt.

Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? - Pregressa esperienza di almeno 2 anni in contesti di consulenza e vendita B2B di servizi/soluzioni digitali nel canale Horeca; - In possesso di Patente B; - Diploma di Scuola Media Superiore; - Ottime doti comunicative e relazionali, passione per la vendita, capacità di pianificazione e organizzazione. title: consulente di ricerca e selezione del personale
description: Per conto di una nota realtà operativa nel settore alberghiero, in vista della nuova apertura di una struttura su Roma, siamo alla ricerca di un/una: HR Manager Le mansioni del ruolo sono le seguenti: Reclutamento e inserimento ? Gestire l'intero processo di reclutamento e selezione per tutte le posizioni della struttura; ? Redigere e pubblicare annunci di lavoro in linea con gli standard editoriali e di brand. ? Condurre colloqui, coordinare i processi di selezione con i responsabili di dipartimento e sottoporre le proprie raccomandazioni al General Manager. ? Organizzare e condurre il processo di onboarding e inserimento di tutti i nuovi dipendenti, affinché ciascuno possa iniziare al meglio fin dal primo giorno. ? Gestire i rapporti con i partner di reclutamento e monitorare l'efficacia dei canali di ricerca (ad es. scuole, università, istituzioni). ? Coordinare la pianificazione e le tempistiche delle assunzioni tra i diversi dipartimenti, per garantire che l'hotel disponga del personale adeguato al momento dell'apertura. Amministrazione e payroll ? Predisporre, verificare e gestire tutti i contratti di lavoro e la relativa documentazione amministrativa, in conformità alla normativa italiana sul lavoro e agli standard del Gruppo. ? Gestire il rilevamento delle presenze, i diritti alle ferie e la pianificazione dei turni, in coordinamento con i responsabili di dipartimento. ? Coordinare la raccolta e la verifica dei dati payroll e interfacciarsi con il fornitore esterno del servizio paghe, garantendo elaborazioni corrette e puntuali. ? Coordinare tutte le formalità amministrative relative all'onboarding e all'offboarding dei dipendenti: documentazione, iscrizione agli enti previdenziali, visite mediche, documenti di cessazione e conteggi finali. ? Garantire la conformità alla normativa italiana sul lavoro e ai contratti collettivi applicabili, in coordinamento con il consulente esterno in materia giuslavoristica. Gestione del personale e relazioni con i dipendenti ? Essere il principale punto di riferimento HR in loco per tutti i dipendenti e i responsabili di dipartimento. ? Monitorare le relazioni tra dipendenti e management, individuando e gestendo proattivamente per tempo eventuali criticità. ? Supportare e consigliare i responsabili di dipartimento nella gestione delle persone, nei procedimenti disciplinari e nelle questioni relative alle prestazioni. ? Gestire le comunicazioni formali, i procedimenti disciplinari e gli eventuali contenziosi, in collaborazione con la Direzione HR di Gruppo; ? Interfacciarsi, quando necessario, con i consulenti legali esterni sulle questioni relative alle relazioni di lavoro. ? Segnalare al General Manager e alla Direttrice HR del Gruppo, secondo necessità, le questioni rilevanti o delicate relative ai rapporti con i dipendenti. ? Promuovere una cultura del lavoro positiva, inclusiva e orientata a prestazioni elevate. Formazione e sviluppo ? Individuare e raccogliere le esigenze formative di tutti i dipartimenti. ? Coordinare e supportare l'erogazione delle sessioni formative in loco. ? Monitorare i piani di sviluppo individuali e assicurare il follow-up dei periodi di prova. ? Contribuire all'individuazione dei talenti e alla pianificazione delle successioni, in collaborazione con il General Manager e la Direttrice HR del Gruppo. Budget, costi del personale e reporting ? Elaborare il budget HR annuale in stretta collaborazione con il General Manager e il management del Gruppo. ? Predisporre report periodici per monitorare i costi del personale, l'organico e il rapporto tra costi del lavoro e budget. ? Contribuire al reporting HR e agli indicatori chiave a livello di Gruppo: organico, assenteismo, ore di formazione, tasso di turnover. ? Fornire regolarmente al General Manager report HR e raccomandazioni pertinenti a supporto delle decisioni operative e relative alla forza lavoro. Requisiti Richiesti: ? Esperienza comprovata in un ruolo di responsabilità di un dipartimento HR (trasversale a tutte le funzioni HR), nel settore dell'ospitalità di lusso. ? Costituisce titolo preferenziale l'esperienza nella gestione autonoma di una funzione HR. ? Solida conoscenza della normativa italiana sul lavoro e delle disposizioni in materia di occupazione, con esperienza nel coordinamento di consulenti legali esterni e fornitori di servizi payroll. ? Esperienza comprovata nella gestione dell'intero processo di reclutamento, compreso l'utilizzo di piattaforme ATS. ? Familiarità con i sistemi informativi HR e gli strumenti payroll. ? Ottima padronanza di Microsoft Office, in particolare di Excel. ? Ottima conoscenza scritta e parlata dell'italiano e dell'inglese. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: Principal System Applications Engineer Solid State Transformer  (SST) (f/m/div) (Ingenieur/in - Mikroelektronik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. Turning customer whispers into industry-shaking solutions... ready to amplify the future?As a Principal System Applications Engineer Solid State Transformer (SST) on our Customer Collaboration and Technical Marketing team work hand-in-hand with our customers, enabling them to transform our products into cutting-edge designs, all while building long-lasting partnerships that thrive on success.Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Engage with leading customers to understand SST architectures, requirements, and technical challenges, translating them into semiconductor and subsystem solutions.- Develop and validate application solutions through simulation, prototyping, measurements, benchmarking, and troubleshooting.- Create technical proof points using PoCs, demonstrators, and experimental validation, including collaboration with external partners.- Convert engineering results into customer-ready technical materials, such as design recommendations, BOM guidance, simulation models, and training content. - Enable Field Application Engineers (FAEs) and regional teams through technical training, workshops, and support for complex customer engagements.- Support strategic customer projects and design-ins, working with customers and internal experts to solve system-level application challenges.Your profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field, combined with 6+ years of industry experience in power electronics, power conversion, or application engineering.- Possess strong expertise in power converter topologies and power semiconductor technologies, with experience in Solid-State Transformers (SSTs), medium-voltage systems, modular converters, or multilevel converters considered a plus.- Demonstrate a broad system-level understanding of gate driving, control, protection, sensing, magnetics, thermal management, and reliability.- Apply hands-on experience in simulation, hardware development, commissioning, measurement, and troubleshooting to develop and validate engineering solutions.- Translate system requirements into practical semiconductor and subsystem recommendations, balancing technical performance and application needs.- Thrive in global, cross-functional environments, showing strong ownership, collaboration, and the ability to influence and drive topics independently across regions, divisions, customers, and external partners.Salary pay information:AustriaAt Infineon in Villach you shape the technologies of tomorrow and work in an international environment with more than 4.700 colleagues from over 70 nations. Your personal contribution will be valued and appreciated as the cornerstones of our success. And all that in beautiful surroundings which guarantee a high quality of life.The City of Villach is located in the center of Carinthia, Austria’s southernmost province, in close proximity to the Italian and Slovenian border. Due to its particular geographic location and the outstanding natural beauty of the region, Villach and the whole province of Carinthia have for generations been popular holiday destinations for people from all over the world. Living in Austria also has many social, health-care-related and economic perks. The country’s social and health care system is among the best in the world and for decades numerous international surveys have singled out Austria as a particularly safe and wealthy country with a high quality of life. Villach benefits from its status as a “small town”, offering everyday living at affordable prices in an outstanding setting.We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group I,J* (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.ItalyLocationIndicative salary rangeMilan, Italy*€63360 – €87120*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Si distingue per la relazione continuativa con i clienti e per un approccio da boutique orientato alla qualità del servizio. Il ruolo Il Direttore Generale affiancherà la proprietà nella definizione e nell'attuazione della strategia aziendale, assumendo la responsabilità del coordinamento complessivo delle attività e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi concordati. Contribuirà al rafforzamento dell'organizzazione e all'evoluzione dell'offerta, con attenzione alla redditività, all'innovazione tecnologica e allo sviluppo delle persone. Principali responsabilità Definire con la proprietà il piano di sviluppo aziendale e tradurlo in obiettivi, budget e priorità operative, monitorandone l'attuazione e proponendo eventuali azioni correttive. Migliorare il modello organizzativo, i processi e gli strumenti di pianificazione e controllo, introducendo responsabilità chiare e indicatori di performance a supporto delle decisioni. Presidiare i risultati economici e gestionali, in collaborazione con la funzione amministrativa, attraverso l'analisi di ricavi, costi, marginalità di progetti e servizi, investimenti e impiego delle risorse. Coordinare le funzioni commerciali, tecniche e operative, assicurando coerenza tra obiettivi di vendita, capacità di erogazione e qualità del servizio al cliente. Sviluppare il business consolidando le relazioni con i clienti strategici, individuando nuove opportunità e favorendo una maggiore integrazione dell'offerta per imprese ed enti pubblici. Guidare l'evoluzione del portafoglio di soluzioni e servizi, valutando tecnologie emergenti e applicazioni dell'intelligenza artificiale in funzione delle esigenze del mercato e del ritorno economico. Valorizzare e sviluppare le competenze dei collaboratori, promuovendo collaborazione tra team, responsabilizzazione e condivisione delle conoscenze. Gestire e sviluppare le relazioni con vendor e partner strategici, collaborando con le funzioni competenti al presidio della qualità, della sicurezza delle informazioni e della compliance. Requisiti e competenze Esperienza in ruoli di direzione generale, direzione di business unit o responsabilità manageriale trasversale nel settore dei servizi, preferibilmente presso system integrator o provider di servizi IT, in alternativa altri servizi B2B es. Digital, TLC... Responsabilità maturata nella gestione di risultati economici, budget e team, con capacità di integrare visione strategica ed esecuzione operativa. Conoscenza del mercato ICT e dei modelli di business legati a progetti, servizi ricorrenti e soluzioni tecnologiche; capacità di valutarne marginalità, complessità operativa e potenziale di sviluppo. Preparazione tecnologica adeguata a confrontarsi con gli specialisti su infrastrutture, networking, cloud e cybersecurity e a orientare le scelte di offerta e investimento. Esperienza nel miglioramento di processi e organizzazione, con capacità di introdurre metodi e strumenti gestionali proporzionati alle esigenze di una piccola impresa. Capacità di costruire un rapporto di fiducia con la proprietà, condividere le priorità e rendicontare con chiarezza risultati, criticità e proposte. Costituiranno elementi preferenziali l'esperienza in contesti imprenditoriali o familiari e la partecipazione a percorsi di evoluzione manageriale. Saranno valorizzate anche la conoscenza del mercato pubblico e dei modelli di noleggio tecnologico. La ricerca è aperta anche a figure provenienti da ruoli di direzione Sales & Delivery, Operations o Commerciale, purché abbiano maturato responsabilità effettive su organizzazione, persone e risultati economici, oltre allo sviluppo delle vendite. Lo stile manageriale Cerchiamo una persona autorevole e concreta, capace di ascoltare, comprendere il contesto e accompagnare il cambiamento in modo costruttivo. Saranno centrali la capacità di coinvolgere collaboratori esperti, prendere decisioni e tradurre le opportunità tecnologiche in iniziative sostenibili per il business. L'opportunità professionale Il ruolo offre la possibilità di contribuire direttamente alla direzione e all'evoluzione di una piccola impresa ICT, lavorando a stretto contatto con la proprietà e incidendo sulle scelte organizzative, commerciali e tecnologiche. Il progetto valorizza una figura manageriale capace di coniugare sviluppo del business, qualità del servizio e continuità delle relazioni con clienti e collaboratori. title: Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) - HRC1792713 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Driving continuous improvement - ready to make quality a culture?As a Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) in our Quality & Excellence team uncover the root causes behind every single error, drive transformational improvements, and implement forward-thinking solutions to ensure our products exceed the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Act as the technical lead and methodological expert for Burn-in (BI), including steering BI decisions, driving continuous improvements, and serving as the primary interface to technology and product development as well as statistics teams- Provide teaching, coaching, and knowledge transfer on Burn-in topics to cross-functional teams, ensuring a consistent and high-quality understanding of BI methodologies across the organization- Support Design for Stress (DfS) sustaining activities, including the management and resolution of DfS Jira Tickets in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders- Serve as the 1st level of support for internal customer inquiries, with a particular focus on** Automotive Governance**, ensuring timely and solution-oriented responses- Drive long-term, strategically important tasks that require sustained attention, ensuring that critical but non-urgent topics receive appropriate prioritization and follow-through- Collaborate closely with Front-End (FE), Back-End (BE) and product development teams, contributing expert knowledge on failure mechanisms, defects, design and test conditions to support informed quality decisions- Lead customer communications about early topics- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), processes, methods, and tools along the entire supply chain, with a strong automotive quality mindsetYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field- At least 6 years of professional work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality management along the supply chain, Front-End and Back-End processes, and reliability testing- Expert-level knowledge in Burn-in methodologies, including deep understanding of physical failure mechanisms, defect analysis, Fault Analysis (FA), and test conditions relevant to semiconductor devices- Proven experience as a technical lead in a cross-functional environment, with the ability to drive decisions, align stakeholders, and manage Design for Stress (DfS) activities effectively- Solid understanding of wafer manufacturing process, foundational skills in data analysis, and familiarity with chip design, test engineering and product development processes- Proficiency in digital collaboration tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Intranet platforms- Show a strong automotive quality mindset and knowledge about automotive requirements- Outstanding interpersonal skills and a genuine service provider attitude, with demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and inspire colleagues while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture- Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plusPlease send us your CV in EnglishPlease note that:- Subject to meeting all job requirements, belonging to protected categories under Law 68/69 will be considered a preferential requirementAdditional information by locationAustriaWe offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H,I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.Salary pay information:In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.LocationIndicative salary rangePadova, Italy*€52,000 – €71,500*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. title: direttore dei sistemi informatici/direttrice dei sistemi informatici
description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Possibili trasferte presso sedi del Gruppo in Italia e all'estero in funzione dei progetti. Inquadramento Contratto a tempo indeterminato, livello Quadro. RAL indicativa 70-80k + bonus variabile 10% Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. La risorsa, riportando al Purchasing Manager, opererà trasversalmente sugli stabilimenti italiani con impatto diretto su continuità produttiva, governance della spesa tecnica e performance dei fornitori. Collaborerà quotidianamente con Engineering, Manutenzione e Plant Management, oltre che con Qualità/HSE, Finance e Legal. Gestirà relazioni con fornitori italiani e internazionali (OEM, integratori, service provider) e, per investimenti o accordi quadro rilevanti, supporterà l'escalation verso General Management e Proprietà. title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description: The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Sertificēts būvniecības un remontdarbu uzņēmums 

SIA  3 baloži(reģ. Nr.: 42103093609), 

sakarā ar darbības paplašināšanos aicina darbā SANTEHNIĶUS. ​

Darbs Liepājā un rajonā.

Prasības:

  • Atbilstošas zināšanas 
  • Darba pieredze.  ​

Darba pienākumi: 

  • Veikt ūdensapgādes, kanalizācijas, apkures, ventilācijas un citu santehnikas sistēmu montāžu, apkopi un remontu.

  • Uzstādīt un pieslēgt santehnikas iekārtas – izlietnes, vannas, tualetes podus, dušas kabīnes, radiatorus, boilerus, sūkņus u.c.

  • Montēt cauruļvadus (metāla, plastmasas, vara u.c. materiālu), veicot nepieciešamos lodēšanas, līmēšanas vai metināšanas darbus.
  • Nodrošināt santehnikas sistēmu pārbaudi, regulēšanu un hermētiskuma testēšanu pēc uzstādīšanas vai remonta.
  • Veikt bojājumu diagnostiku un novēršanu esošajās santehnikas sistēmās.
  • Veikt profilaktiskos uzturēšanas darbus, lai novērstu noplūdes, aizsērējumus vai citas sistēmu darbības problēmas.
  • Nodrošināt darbu atbilstību būvprojekta prasībām, tehniskajām specifikācijām un normatīvajiem aktiem.
  • Strādāt droši, ievērojot darba aizsardzības, ugunsdrošības un vides aizsardzības noteikumus.
  •  Sadarboties ar citiem speciālistiem (elektriķiem, būvniekiem, apkures meistariem u.c.) kopīgu projektu īstenošanā.
  • Uzturēt kārtību un tīrību darba vietā, taupīgi izmantot materiālus un instrumentus.
  • Pildīt citus tiešā vadītāja norādījumus, kas saistīti ar santehnikas uzstādīšanu un uzturēšanu, atbilstoši darbinieka kvalifikācijai.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.

Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt. Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.
