title: MES Solution Architect
description: Join us in shaping the future of digital manufacturing at Nobia Park!At Nobia Park, we're building one of Europe's most modern manufacturing environments. Our factory combines advanced automation, digitalization, and lean operations to create a highly efficient and future-focused production setup.We are now looking for a MES Solution Architect to play a key role in designing, developing, and evolving the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions that support our production and logistics operations.This is a unique opportunity to join a large-scale transformation journey where technology, processes, and people come together to create the factory of the future.Where we are right nowNobia is in one of the most exciting phases in its history. As part of our transformation journey, we are continuously developing the digital capabilities that support our highly automated production environment at Nobia Park in Jönköping.As production volumes continue to increase and new capabilities are introduced, the need for scalable, integrated and business-driven MES solutions becomes even more important. We are therefore strengthening our MES organization and expanding our internal capability to design, develop, and support solutions that create value across manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, and supply chain operations.About the roleAs a MES Solution Architect, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting business-critical MES solutions that enable efficient and reliable operations across the factory.Acting as the bridge between business processes and technical execution, you will ensure that solutions are scalable, integrated, and aligned with both business objectives and architectural standards.The role combines solution architecture, stakeholder collaboration, process development, and continuous improvement in a highly automated manufacturing environment.Your responsibilities    Translate business requirements into scalable and effective MES solutions, ensuring alignment with both operational needs and architectural standards.    Design and support integrations between MES, SAP S/4HANA, production equipment, and other business-critical systems.    Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, MES Solution Engineers, and external partners throughout the design, development, testing, and implementation lifecycle.    Contribute to the evolution of MES architecture, development standards, governance, and future ways of working.    Drive continuous improvement initiatives, support incident management, and contribute to increased operational efficiency, system stability, and production performance.Location: Nobia Park, Jönköping. This is an on-site position.Who you areTo succeed in this role, you are a proactive and collaborative professional who enjoys working where manufacturing processes and technology meet.You have the ability to understand operational needs and translate them into sustainable system solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, engaging with stakeholders across different functions, and driving improvements that create measurable business value.You are comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving and thrive in an environment where technology plays a critical role in operational success.Most importantly, you are motivated by being part of a transformation journey where your expertise will help shape the digital manufacturing landscape of one of Europe's most advanced production facilities.We believe you bring    5+ years of experience working with MES solutions in manufacturing environments, preferably within highly automated production facilities.    Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, MES architecture, and system integrations across MES, ERP (preferably SAP S/4HANA), machines and shop floor technologies.    Experience with C#, T-SQL, Microsoft SQL Server, relational databases, and industrial communication standards such as OPC UA.    Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.    Fluency in Swedish and English.It is highly desirable if you have    Experience with Insight2020.    Experience working in Agile development environments.About NobiaNobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist and part of everyday life for millions of people, with the kitchen playing an increasingly important role in modern homes. The Group consists of eighteen strong brands, including Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form.At Nobia, you will have the opportunity to be part of a modern manufacturing environment where you can make a real impact. A six-month probationary period can be applied.For questions regarding the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist josephine.tjernlund@nobia.comWe look forward to welcoming you to our team!

title: Global Key Customer Manager
description: Company description:At Epiroc, we collaborate with some of the world’s leading mining companies to address these challenges. We are now looking for a Global Key Account Manager who wants to contribute to developing these long-term partnerships and creating value for both our customers and Epiroc. This is a role for someone with a deep understanding of the mining industry who thrives at the intersection of people, technology, operational development, and business. You see the bigger picture of a mining operation and are motivated by building collaborations that make a real difference over time.Job description:Your missionAs a Global Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing and driving collaboration with some of Epiroc’s most strategically important global customers.You will work closely with both customer leadership teams and operational stakeholders, as well as colleagues across Epiroc, to identify opportunities, develop joint strategies, and ensure long-term growth for both parties.The role includes, among other things:     Develop and implement global account strategies for selected key customers.     Build long-term trust through presence, understanding, and strategic partnership.     Identify business opportunities within equipment, aftermarket services, automation, digitalization, and sustainable mining.     Coordinate customer activities across regions, divisions, and functions within Epiroc.     Act as a trusted advisor by understanding customer challenges and translating them into value-creating solutions.     Drive growth through both existing business and new business opportunities.     Ensure close collaboration between customer organizations and Epiroc’s global organization.     Develop a deep understanding of customers’ strategic priorities and future challenges.     Coordinate resources and expertise from different parts of Epiroc’s organization to meet customer needs.     Identify opportunities where Epiroc and the customer can create greater value together.     Contribute to the development of future solutions within automation, electrification, digitalization, and sustainable mining.     Ensure customer perspectives and needs are translated into concrete initiatives within Epiroc. Your profile We believe you have experience from the mining industry or a related industrial environment and a strong understanding of customers’ day-to-day operations, challenges, and long-term objectives. You understand the interplay between production, technology, maintenance, safety, and business performance.You may, for example, have worked as:     Mine Manager     Production Manager     Mining Engineering Manager or Mining Engineer     Mining Industry Consultant     Site Manager     Technical Services Manager     Mine Planning Manager or Engineer The most important thing is not your current title, but that you understand how value is created in the mining industry and can translate that understanding into strong, long-term business relationships.We would like you to have:     Solid experience from the mining industry.     A strong understanding of operational and strategic mining challenges.     Experience working across multiple functions and stakeholders.     The ability to create engagement and collaboration across organizational boundaries.     Strong communication skills and experience building relationships at both operational and strategic levels.     A genuine interest in people, technology, and business development.     Excellent English language skills. To thrive in this role, we believe you:     Are curious about how the mining industry is evolving.     Have a strong interest in both technology and business.     Are proactive, with a focus on results and long-term value creation.     Are skilled at creating engagement and fostering collaboration.     Are comfortable working in international environments and across different cultures.     Enjoy building relationships and earning trust over time.     See opportunities where others see complexity.     Have a strong holistic perspective and understand both operations and business.     Enjoy bringing people together around shared goals. title: Lecturer in reproductive and perinatal health (Midwifery)
description: Lecturer in reproductive and perinatal health (Midwifery)Reference number PAR 2026/894The University of Gothenburg tackles society’s challenges with diverse knowledge. 58 000 students and 6800 employees make the university a large and inspiring place to work and study. Strong research and attractive study programmes attract researchers and students from around the world. With new knowledge and new perspectives, the University contributes to a better future.The Department of Health and Care Sciences conducts education and research focusing on healthcare, health and people's living conditions. We educate nurses, radiographers, specialist nurses and midwives, with the aim of meeting society's need for skilled and committed healthcare professionals.Research at the Department covers a wide range of areas, with a shared foundation in person-centred and evidence-based care. We are nationally and internationally recognised as a leader in person-centred care, an approach that underpins our education, research and collaboration with healthcare providers.The Department is part of Sahlgrenska Academy at the University of Gothenburg and is located at Campus Medicinareberget, close to Sahlgrenska University Hospital. This provides an environment characterised by interprofessional collaboration, strong links to clinical practice and high academic standards. The Department has approximately 1,200 students enrolled in first- and second-cycle programmes leading to professional qualifications in healthcare.We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and with different experiences and perspectives. We value diversity and actively promote an inclusive and equal working environment where all employees have opportunities to thrive and develop. To support a healthy work-life balance, we offer flexible working arrangements.The University of Gothenburg is a Swedish government agency, which means that employees benefit from favourable employment conditions, generous annual leave and an occupational pension scheme.Read more about working at the University of Gothenburg on our website: Work at the University of GothenburgWe are looking for a colleague with a strong interest in teaching and a commitment to course development and the advancement of teaching and learning. The successful applicant should be highly motivated to share knowledge with students and demonstrate a strong commitment to educational development.The position will primarily be based in the Section for Diagnostics and Care in Acute and Critical Conditions / Reproductive and Perinatal Health. Teaching will mainly take place within the Midwifery Programme. Depending on operational needs, duties may also involve collaboration with other sections within the Department.Subject area Reproductive and perinatal healthSubject area description Reproductive and perinatal health is grounded in a humanistic view of the person and generates knowledge about human reproduction and its processes. This encompasses sexuality, fertility, abortion, contraception, pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, the neonatal period, parenthood and menopause.    Duties Teaching will primarily focus on subject-specific areas related to the midwifery profession and its core competencies: person-centred care, safe care, health informatics, teamwork, evidence-based care, leadership, interprofessional learning and pedagogy.The duties include teaching and assessment, course coordination, supervision of degree projects and supervision of students during clinical placements. The position primarily involves planning and teaching at second-cycle level, keeping up to date with developments in relevant subject areas, the professional role of the midwife, person-centred leadership and clinically integrated learning. The duties also include teaching and supervision at first-cycle level, as well as course coordination at both first- and second-cycle levels.As course coordinator, responsibilities include developing and coordinating learning outcomes, learning activities, assessment methods and assessment criteria in relation to course content, objectives and current research in higher education pedagogy. Acting as a university liaison for students undertaking clinical placements is an important part of the position. The role also involves ensuring the quality of education through validated evaluation methods. Some teaching of clinical skills is also included.Administrative duties related to educational activities constitute a significant part of the role. Other duties may also be assigned, and the responsibilities associated with the position may change over time.The position also involves actively contributing to the achievement of the Department's objectives and operational plan. This includes supporting the development of the academic environment within the section's Complete Academic Environment (KAM). In addition, all staff members are expected to participate in scheduled departmental meetings and joint activities.The successful candidate will teach in both Swedish and English.See more info on the University of Gothenburgs homepage job opportunities.Göteborgs universitet | Lecturer in reproductive and perinatal health (Midwifery)

Vi är en referens inom teknik och installation av renrum och kritiska områden på internationell nivå, med närvaro i mer än 10 länder och över 20 års erfarenhet. Valtria är en del av den franska industrikoncernen Clauger, vilket ger oss en stark industriell och finansiell stabilitet i ryggen under vår fortsatta tillväxt i länder där vi expanderar, såsom Sverige.Vårt värdeerbjudande vilar på tre grundpelare: att förstå det unika hos varje kund och projekt, att erbjuda skräddarsydda lösningar utifrån deras behov, samt vårt experterteams förmåga till ständig förbättring och innovation genom användning av den senaste tekniken i en bransch som rör sig i hög hastighet.Vi bygger förtroendefulla relationer med våra kunder, verksamma inom ledande sektorer, eftersom vi varje dag lever och praktiserar våra värderingar: professionalism, engagemang, teamwork och transparens. Att arbeta på Valtria innebär att vara en del av ett fantastiskt team med passion för sitt arbete. Vi strävar varje dag efter att våra kunder ska välja oss igen.Vill du bli en del av vårt team?I den här rekryteringen samarbetar vi med Randstad Engineering. För frågor om rollen eller rekryteringsprocessen välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Hannah Sandström, hannah.sandstrom@randstad.seAnsvarsområdenTechnical Design Engineer ansvarar för utveckling och utarbetande av tekniska och kommersiella anbud för projekt, med följande ansvarsområden:    Analysera kundens behov och föreslå den bäst lämpade tekniska lösningen.    Genomföra tekniska beräkningar och ekonomiska kostnadsuppskattningar för projekten.    Följa upp och övervaka revideringar av anbud och offerter.    Överföra projektinformation och underlag för nya projekt till produktionsavdelningen.    Efterleva kvalitets-, säkerhets- och miljöstandarder, lämna förslag på förbättringar och innovation samt samarbeta med teamet i liknande uppgifter för att nå avdelningens mål.KvalifikationerKrav    Minst 3 års erfarenhet av att utarbeta tekniska anbud/offerter för HVAC-tekniska projekt krävs.    Dokumenterad erfarenhet inom HVAC engineering samt stark teknisk bakgrund inom ingenjörsvetenskap krävs.    Kandidatexamen (Bachelor's degree) inom ingenjörsvetenskap – HVAC, automation, bygg/konstruktion eller motsvarande krävs.    God vana av Microsoft Office samt CAD-programvara (t.ex. för granskning och visualisering av ritningar/designer) krävs.    Flytande/avancerad nivå i både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift krävs.    B-körkort samt tillgänglighet för korta och tillfälliga resor inom Sverige krävs.Meriterande    Erfarenhet från renrumsbranschen (cleanrooms) eller närliggande tekniska specialistområden är meriterande.    Kunskap om renrumsstandarder (t.ex. ISO-klassificeringar), designprinciper, luftflödesdynamik, filtreringssystem och kontamineringskontroll är meriterande.    Genomgången utbildning inom arbetsmiljö och säkerhet (HSE / Safety training) är meriterande.    Vana av CRM-plattformar för sälj- och anbudsprocesser är meriterande.Om företagetVALTRIA SWEDEN AB𝗪𝗲 𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘇𝗲 𝗶𝗻 𝗰𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗶𝘇𝗲𝗱 𝗰𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗻𝗿𝗼𝗼𝗺𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗱 𝗲𝗻𝘃𝗶𝗿𝗼𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀, 𝗯𝗶𝗼𝘀𝗮𝗳𝗲𝘁𝘆 𝗳𝗮𝗰𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀-𝗼𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗻𝗸𝗲𝘆 𝘀𝗼𝗹𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀.We provide tailored, functional technical solutions for each project entrusted to us by our clients, aligning with their needs, expectations, and resources. title: System Business Analyst, Lund
description: Do you have a passion for sales & marketing processes and systems and want to support Axis Sales & Marketing organization in our growth? Then you could be the one we are looking for!The Systems Governance team in Global Sales & Marketing is now looking for a new team member who can support with requirements management, process alignment and system implementation in our sales & marketing systems.Who is your future team?The Systems Governance team is part of Global Sales & Marketing and based in Lund, Sweden. The team focuses on the governance of sales & marketing systems and processes, all with the aim of upholding common global framework, pursuing business efficiency and scalability. This means working closely with representatives from the Head Regions, colleagues within Information Systems, Global Sales & Marketing organization, as well as functions at Axis headquarters.The team has an important mission in supporting our sales & marketing organization with the systems and tools to do their jobs more effectively and efficiently and to best serve our customers and partners globally. A highly exciting area to work with and create an impact within!What you will do here as a System Business Analyst?As a Systems Business Analyst you will play a key part in pursuing increased business efficiency and global alignment through sales & marketing systems and tools - main focus in this role being on marketing systems and processes, primarily Salesforce Marketing Cloud.Before it's decided to develop and implement any improvements or new functionality, an analysis and specification of the requirements is needed, as well as mapping & alignment of underlying processes. You will also ensure that the agreed improvements are rolled out timely and successfully towards users. In this role you will closely work with Information Systems, Head-Regions and Global Sales & MarketingKey responsibility areas include, but are not limited to:    Manage requirements:     Drive business analysis through considering stakeholder needs with a view of the capabilities of the platforms.    Analyze and specify the benefits, consequences, impact on business etc. of incoming requirements.    Map underlying processes and ensure global alignment with the Global Process Owner.    Cooperate with Marketing, Sales and Information Systems stakeholders to drive alignment and efficiency of connected sales and marketing processes that are supported through the system.    Manage system implementation:     Specify requests as a base for product owner/s to approve and prioritize.    Translate the requested needs from users into business user stories/acceptance criteria for development.    Help verify technical acceptance criteria for approved development of the systems.    Together with process experts and users test changes prior to release.    Facilitate base documentation to support post-release process where necessary.    Focus areas are Salesforce Marketing Cloud as well as other marketing systems & processes, but support through the above in sales systems and processes may be relevant as required.    Drive assigned projects and tasks and any other ad hoc duties as and when required.Who are we looking for?Axis is looking for a driven, proactive and structured individual with the ability to drive initiatives forward in an aligned and efficient way. You are a good communicator with strong people and networking skills and with a good ability to coordinate between many stakeholders, mainly within Axis. You like to work in a global environment characterized by teamwork. As there are many parallel projects/tasks/requests that will be investigated, developed and/or implemented at the same time, you will need to be structured, good at setting priorities and with good time management skills.As a person you are motivated by working in a high-pace organization where you can deliver results together with your colleagues. You are not afraid to navigate in an environment of change and you are open to thinking outside the box. Managing the above means that you are service minded yet focused on details and make sure that processes, procedures and timelines are followed. When necessary, you challenge the information provided to you and you ensure driving a common, global way of working.We believe that you have:    Proven experience in business analysis, requirements management, or a similar role within Salesforce Marketing Cloud    Strong understanding of marketing processes    Experience within marketing systems    Experience with managing multiple stakeholders    Strong coordination and stakeholder management abilities    Experience with investigating, analyzing and coordinating change requestsThe following qualifications are a plus:    Bachelor's degree in marketing or other related area    Experience in leading/implementing system improvement initiative(s)    Experience from working internationally    Experience from marketing systems such as Cvent, Envoy or Monday.comThe position will be based in our headquarters in Lund. Travel may be required. Travel needs are planned in alignment with your manager and the team.What Axis has to offerWe are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.Ready to Act?We go through applications continuously so don't wait - send in your application today!In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Linnea Polito at +46 46 272 1800

title: Software Developer Consultant at Codic Consulting
description: About the opportunityAre you an experienced software developer looking for new challenges?At Codic Consulting, we work with some of Gothenburg’s leading technology companies across industries such as aviation and automotive. We are looking for skilled software developers who enjoy solving complex problems, building reliable software, and continuously developing their technical expertise.As a consultant at Codic, you will have the opportunity to work on challenging assignments involving software development, cloud technologies, system integrations, and modern software solutions. Your assignments will depend on your technical background, experience, and interests.Who are we looking for?We are looking for experienced software developers with at least five years of professional experience.Ideally, you have experience in several of the following areas:    Software development using Python, Java, or C#/.NET    Backend development, APIs, and system integrations    Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP    Microservices and distributed systems    Databases and data management    Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD    Agile software developmentExperience from industries such as aviation or automotive is considered an advantage but is not required.We value technical curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with others.Professional proficiency in English is required.Why join Codic?Codic Consulting is a small and responsive IT consultancy based in Gothenburg, Sweden.With us, you get the best of both worlds: the opportunity to work on international projects at some of the region’s leading technology companies while being part of a close-knit consultancy with colleagues from around the world.We believe that professional development, work-life balance, and a supportive working environment are essential for long-term success.As part of Codic, we offer:    Competitive salary and employment conditions covered by Swedish collective agreements    Annual wellness allowance of 5,000 SEK    Professional development allowance of up to 25,000 SEK or four days per year    Regular one-on-one meetings with your manager    Company bike benefit    Access to technical equipment and opportunities to develop your own projects    Social activities, technical discussions, and team eventsRelocation to SwedenWe welcome applications from experienced software developers living outside Sweden.For suitable candidates, we can provide support throughout the relocation process, including guidance on practical and administrative matters related to moving to Gothenburg.Interested?If you’re passionate about software development and interested in joining a consultancy that values both technical excellence and its people, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Postdoc in Computer Science specializing in Quantum Computing
description: Mälardalen University (MDU) is the youngest university in Sweden. In line with our vision, to be a progressive and collaborative University where we shape a sustainable future together, we wish to make a difference.Do you want to be involved and contribute to our development?Together, we can create a sustainable future through knowledge and innovation. We believe that knowledge and new perspectives are best attained and reached together in collaboration with others – our colleagues, students, the private and public sectors, both nationally and internationally.The Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences provides education and conducts research in engineering, health and information design, with a clear focus on addressing societal challenges. Our research is carried out in close collaboration with external partners, both nationally and internationally, and contributes to knowledge development and innovation. Through our collaboration platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector and industry to jointly drive knowledge development and strengthen the relevance of research and education. Education at all levels is research-based and closely aligned with the needs of society and working life. Together, we contribute to sustainable societal development.The Faculty comprises three departments with a total of approximately 500 staff.The Department of Computer Science and Engineering conducts internationally recognised research in close collaboration with industry, the public sector and other higher education institutions, in areas including artificial intelligence, dependable systems, embedded systems, and medical and health technologies. The department educates students in fields such as computer science, software engineering, computer networks, applied AI, dependable systems, cybersecurity, and intelligent embedded systems.Employment information Employment: Temporary employment, 2 years Period of employment/Start date: March 2027 or as soon as possible Scope: Full time Number of positions: 1 Closing date for application: 2026-12-31 Campus location: Västerås School: Datavetenskap och datateknikPosition descriptionThe purpose of the position is to give the employee an early opportunity to develop his or her independence as a researcher and to create the conditions for further acquisitions of qualifications after completing the doctoral degree. The position is a temporary employment with a maximum period of 3 years. As postdoc in the Chips-JU uPQComing project, the candidate is expected to lead their line of research, both individually and in collaboration with other project members, both at MDU and in the consortium. The tasks involved in the employment include also co-supervision of PhD students, project meetings, participation and presentation at research venues as well as project reporting events. The postdoc is expected to teach for 10% of their employment time.Qualification requirementsThe applicant is required to have a PhD in Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or Quantum ComputingThe applicant must have completed the degree no more than three years before the end of the application period. You have not previously held a position as a postdoctoral researcher in the same or related subject area at MDU that exceeds one year.Documented research in quantum computing is required. The candidate shall demonstrate advanced skills in conducting both research and implementation tasks (e.g. first-/single-author publications, own GitHub repository, etc.). Written and oral communication skills: demonstrates the ability to communicate ideas clearly and persuasively, both in writing and orally. This includes the ability to articulate complex concepts in accessible language during one-to-one meetings and presentations to both small and large groups. Requirements for employment are the ability to teach and conduct research in English.This position involves work within a research project where access to certain research results, methods, technical systems, software or other information may be regulated by export control, security or sanctions legislation. The successful candidate must therefore be able to meet the requirements set out in the relevant legislation in order to gain access to the project’s research environment and to be able to carry out the duties of the position. A security clearance or other legally justified checks may be carried out if the nature of the position requires so.  Assessment criteriaFor this position, particular emphasis will be placed on:     Documented knowledge and research in (post-)quantum cryptography and/or cybersecurity is considered a merit    Knowledge of digital-twins is considered a merit    Documented collaborations with researchers outside their own supervision team and/or with industry are considered a merit This advert is abridged. To see the full advert, please go to: Job opportunities - Mälardalen University We value the qualities that an even distribution of age and gender, as well as ethnic and cultural diversity, can contribute to the organisation.ApplicationThe application is to be completed online. Please submit your application by clicking on the "Apply" button below.The scientific publications that you do not have in digital form are to be sent by post to:Mälardalen University Division of Human Resources Ref.no: 2026/2092 Box 883 SE-721 23 Västerås, SWEDENThe applicant is responsible for ensuring that the application is complete in accordance with the advertisement and will reach the university no later than closing date for application.We look forward to receiving your application!Union representatives:Saco-S mailto:saco-s@mdu.se Susanne Meijer ST-OFR/S, phone: +46 21-10 14 89We decline all contact with recruiters and sellers of advertisements. We have made our strategic choices for this recruitment.

title: Technician - Mechanical
description: Job Scope Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function. The Mechanical Technician is directly responsible for preventive and planned maintenance of the stacking and notching tools. The mechanical technician will be responsible for the day-to day hands-on operations including creating work instructions. This role implies responsibility for the quality and workmanship / maintenance of tools and if needed parts that are manufactured. Purpose is to support manufacturing operations by performing mechanical, machining, tooling and workshop related activities, ensuring that equipment, tools, fixtures and components are available, functional and meet required quality and safety standards.  Key Responsibilities Overall areas of responsibilities and activities Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)     During startup phase – assist with department / workshop & stores set up and document creation.     Carry out planned and preventative maintenance of production dies, tooling, jigs, and fixtures     Read technical drawings and build tools and assemblies accordingly.     Operate machines to carry out repairs, modifications, and new parts.     Precision Grinding of cutting tools.     Support Engineering requests for tooling related issues improvements.     Ensure spare parts which are used on tools are booked out and logged in TC (Team Center).     Suggest design changes for tools and equipment to improve efficiency, quality, Life.     Inspect components to detect wear, vibrations, or not proper lubrication.     Assist with department set up to ensure good 5S standards.     Safety concept as it relates to the material handling equipment or parts storage.     Train others in maintenance specific tasks.     Provide regular feedback and participation in departmental meetings.     The Mechanical Technician will be responsible for the quality and workmanship of the tools they maintain and parts they procedure.     Together with the rest of the team, being a key player to develop and maintain a good and safe work environment.       Contribute to the delivery of department objectives.     Carry out all reasonable request to help the department. Requirements Educational background and previous experience required for the role     Mechanical Technical or mechanical machinist background  Qualifications and Experience     Min. 2 years industrial experience within tool maintenance department     Good understanding of technical drawings     Fluency in English     Good computer literacy     Excellent MS Office knowledge     Good understanding of quality and problem-solving tools Specific skills & Knowledge      Good technical knowledge about mechanical, hydraulics, and pneumatics.     Good knowledge and understanding of limits and fits.     Working with continuous improvement

title: Outlet Manager
description: Role SummaryThe Outlet Manager runs day-to-day operations at Uma's Momo, a fast-casual restaurant and take-away in Gothenburg, as we prepare to open our next location. The role goes beyond running a single outlet: the successful candidate will build structured, practical ways of working that support both our current restaurant and our next location, focused on guest issue resolution, demand-based staffing, delivery-order handling, learning from incidents, quality checks and coaching, guest feedback, and training new staff. We are looking for a calm, methodical problem-solver with a strong focus on the guest experience and the ability to turn feedback and data into improvements on the floor. title: Customer Contract Manager
description: A Snapshot of Your Day Ready to make a real impact? As a Customer Contract Manager (CCM), you will drive our service contracts and be the trusted partner our customers rely on. You will leverage your strong commitment and understanding of customer needs to ensure high satisfaction levels. In this role, you will be part of the project management office for Long Term Program & Overhauls, responsible for delivering exceptional services to our gas turbine customers in the Power Generation and Oil & Gas industries, within Middle East and Americas. Regular visits to customers and collaboration with regional Siemens Energy colleagues will be essential, making international travel a key aspect of your role. How You’ll Make an Impact     You will take full responsibility for your service contracts, ensuring their successful execution and delivery.     Lead a cross-functional project team, collaborating with colleagues from engineering, commercial project management, overhaul project management, and more.     Build trust and maintain transparent communication as the primary contact for your customers.     Develop long-term relationships by understanding your customers’ needs, decision-making processes, and key stakeholders, while also fostering strong connections with Siemens Energy regional colleagues.     Identify customer needs, promote our service products, and uncover opportunities for additional sales.     Structure and plan contract activities on time, aligning with customer requirements.     Travel to customer sites to negotiate and follow up on contracts alongside local representatives. What You Bring     Previous experience in international business, such as sales or project management.     Strong negotiation skills, with confidence in communication at various levels and the ability to deliver under pressure.     A collaborative spirit and the ability to work effectively with diverse teams and cultures.     A proactive, can-do attitude that drives results.     A strong commitment to making a difference every day.     Understanding of advanced risk and opportunity management to create win-win situations. About the Team     Diverse team: We are a team with different ages, backgrounds and experiences, and we value the different perspectives this brings.     Different roles, one goal: Our team brings together different roles and competencies, such as contract management and overhaul project management. Together we deliver on our commitments to our customers.     Learning from each other: Experienced colleagues and newer team members share knowledge, and we grow by learning from one another.     Collaboration and inclusion: We work closely together across cultures and regions with a strong team spirit. Everyone's voice counts. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. title: Field Service Engineer (South Sweden - Remote)
description: We don’t just build technology. We build hope for everyone dealing with Cancer.Elekta is shaping the standard of care, together with healthcare providers, by developing precision radiation medicine that brings advanced radiotherapy into routine clinical practice. Our solutions support consistent, efficient and personalized care, addressing evolving patient needs. Through adaptive radiotherapy, precision treatment delivery and integrated workflows, Elekta supports care teams across a range of clinical settings. Each year more than 2 million patients are treated using Elekta solutions across over 130 countries. Elekta is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, with over 4,000 employees and offices in more than 40 countries. The company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. For more information, visit elekta.com.What You’ll Do At ElektaAs a Field Service Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the performance, reliability, and safety of Elekta’s advanced radiotherapy solutions across the Nordic region, with a primary focus on MR-Linac systems. Reporting to the Regional Service Manager, you will work independently to install, maintain, troubleshoot, and support highly sophisticated medical technology that directly contributes to patient care.This is a home-based position requiring frequent travel throughout the Nordic region and occasional travel outside the region. Due to the location of our clients, we prefer candidates who are based in southern Sweden. You will work closely with customers, colleagues, and technical support teams to deliver exceptional service and maintain strong long-term customer relationships. Responsibilities     Install, commission, upgrade, and maintain Elekta systems, with a focus on MR-Linac solutions.     Perform planned preventive maintenance and emergency corrective maintenance activities at customer sites.     Diagnose and repair complex electronic, mechanical, networking, and software-related issues down to board and component level.     Support customers through on-site visits, courtesy calls, and remote technical assistance.     Manage service activities independently while ensuring timely escalation of complex technical issues when required.     Complete service documentation, reports, and quality records accurately and on time.     Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with Elekta quality standards, safety procedures, and regulatory requirements.     Build strong relationships with customers through professional, responsive, and customer-focused support.     Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service quality and customer satisfaction.     Promote service upgrades, system enhancements, and additional solutions where appropriate.     Maintain technical expertise across Elekta's service portfolio through ongoing training and development.     Share knowledge and provide guidance or training to colleagues when required.     Support occasional weekend service activities, typically limited to business-critical customer needs.What You’ll Bring     Degree, HNC, technical diploma, or equivalent qualification in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Medical Engineering, or a related discipline.     Demonstrated experience in field service, technical support, installation, or maintenance engineering environment.     Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding capabilities across complex electro-mechanical systems.     Experience working with electronics, networking, PCs, servers, and Windows-based environments.     Knowledge of high/low voltage systems, vacuum systems, RF technology, diagnostic equipment, or other advanced engineering disciplines is highly desirable.     Ability to analyze problems systematically and identify effective solutions under pressure.     Strong customer service mindset with the ability to build credibility and trust with healthcare professionals.     Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Knowledge of a Nordic language is advantageous.     Ability to work independently, prioritize workloads, and manage multiple service activities simultaneously.     Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40% of the time throughout the Nordic region and occasionally internationally.     Valid driving license.     A collaborative, proactive, and safety-focused approach to work. What You'll Get     30 paid vacation days per year     4 additional Elekta days off     Defined contribution pension scheme     Private Medical Insurance     Lunch benefit     Contribution to wellness activities     Collaborative office environment with opportunities to work alongside talented colleagues in a supportive and engaging workplace Application Process We look forward to receiving your application. Please submit your CV in English via the “Apply” button. We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage early applications.

und Kollektionen überzeugend### Was ist uns wichtig*      Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Fashion Design, Textildesign oder einem verwandten Bereich sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Modedesign, einschliesslich fundierter Erfahrung im Bereich Menswear*      Du kennst das Markt\- und Wettbewerbsumfeld, verstehst die Positionierung von CALIDA und die Bedürfnisse unserer Zusammenarbeit*      Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse; ösischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil*      Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Adobe Illustrator und Photoshop. Kenntnisse in Tex Define, 3D\-Design und KI\-gestützten Designtools sind ein Plus      ### Deine Benefits* Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Mobile / Remote Working* Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Kostenbeteiligung für Weiterbildungen zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung* Kostenübernahme der KTG\- \& NBU\-Prämien* Kostenlose Parkplätze für alle Mitarbeitenden am Hauptsitz sowie vergünstigte Verpflegung in unserem Personalrestaurant Yellows.* Erlebe unvergessliche Momente bei unseren regelmässigen CALIDA Yellow's Apéro sowie bei unserer einzigartigen Weihnachtsfeier* Attraktive Mitarbeitendenrabatte bei unseren Brands sowie regelmässige Rampenverkäufe  ### Dein Kontakt   **Frau**     Senior HR Business Partner            ### Unser Rekrutierungsprozess:Bei uns erwartet dich ein transparenter und persönlicher Rekrutierungsprozess, der deine Fähigkeiten und Persönlichkeit in den Mittelpunkt stellt.     **1\. title: Senior Storage & Data Engineer
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Senior Storage &amp; Data Engineer--- Senior Storage \& Data Engineer===============================Senior Storage \& Data Engineer===============================**The Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS)** develops and operates a high\-performance computing and data research infrastructure that supports world\-class science in Switzerland. Its user laboratory is available to domestic and international researchers in academia, industry, and the business sector. The centre is operated by ETH Zurich and has offices at its data centre in Lugano and in Zurich.For this position the work location is either Lugano or Zürich. The contract is for two years.Project background------------------Storing petabytes is the easy part. The hard part is everything between the moment data lands on disk and the moment a researcher — or a training job — can actually trust it, find it, and use it.  Our parallel filesystems and object stores already move data fast. What they don't do on their own is tell a scientist where a dataset came from, which transformations produced it, whether it's the version that backed last quarter's published result, or how to feed it to a DataLoader without saturating the I/O subsystem. That gap — between raw bytes and usable, traceable, reproducible data — is where this role lives.  You'll work at both ends: the storage layer (throughput, integrity, tiering at multi\-petabyte scale) and the data layer above it (lineage, provenance, discoverability, access patterns). If you've ever been annoyed that *"the data is on the cluster"* gets treated as the end of the job rather than the start of it, read on.description-----------* **Bridge ingestion and use.** Design the pipelines and metadata that turn ingested data into something findable and consumable — catalogs, schemas, and access layers that match how training jobs and simulations actually read, not just where bytes sit.* **Make data traceable.** Build lineage and provenance so any dataset, checkpoint, or result can be traced back to its inputs and transformations. Reproducibility is a first\-class requirement here, not a retrofit.* **Tune for the workload.** Optimise parallel filesystems (Lustre, GPFS) and object storage for the concurrency, small\-file, and large\-checkpoint patterns of distributed GPU training and HPC simulation.* **Operate at scale, safely.** Design and run multi\-petabyte storage with the integrity and availability scientific work depends on — erasure coding, redundancy, hot\-to\-archival tiering.* **Automate everything.** Deploy and scale storage and data services as code. Snowflake infrastructure doesn't survive at this scale.* **Make it observable.** Instrument storage health, capacity trends, and pipeline performance so problems surface before users feel them.* **Translate.** Turn real access patterns from domain scientists and ML engineers into technical requirements — and push back when a request would quietly break something downstream.For a project in the weather and climate domain, aimed at understanding and mitigating the impact of climate change, an opening for **two years** is available.The initial two\-year contract could potentially be extended or even become permanent.Profile-------* A technical degree (CS, engineering) **or** equivalent experience that demonstrates the same depth.* Solid storage grounding: filesystems (block and object), performance tuning, redundancy (RAID, erasure coding).* , and comfort automating infrastructure (Ansible, Terraform, or similar).* A working understanding of how ML and scientific workloads consume data — billions of small files, large checkpoints, sharding — and why naive layouts fall over.* A point of view on data lineage, provenance, or reproducibility — and ideally tooling you've used to enforce it.**What helps you stand out*** Hands\-on parallel filesystems (Lustre, Spectrum Scale/GPFS) or distributed storage (Ceph, VAST).* Scientific data formats — HDF5, Zarr, Parquet — and opinions on when each earns its place.* Object storage (S3\) interfaced with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).* Orchestration (Kubernetes, Argo) and data\-movement tooling.* Data versioning / cataloguing (e.g. DVC, lakeFS, a metadata catalog) and familiarity with FAIR data principles.* CI/CD and provisioning: GitLab CI, HashiCorp Vault, MAAS.We don't expect every box ticked. Depth in storage *or* data engineering, plus the curiosity to grow into the other, matters more than a complete checklist.**What you get*** Hardware and scale you won't find in enterprise IT — and problems with no vendor playbook.* Work that directly enables published science and frontier\-scale model training.* Room to shape how data is *managed*, not just maintained, in an environment that takes it seriously.**Our core values as guiding principles:*** Curiosity: You enjoy learning and understanding systems deeply* Openness: You collaborate effectively and value different perspectives* Courage: You are willing to tackle difficult or unfamiliar problems* Supportive: You help colleagues and users succeed* Integrity: You act responsibly, reliably, and transparentlyWe offer--------We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive engineering team and particularly encourage applications from groups underrepresented in tech. If you are technically adept, curious, and eager to grow, we want to hear from you.* Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society* You can expect , such as public transport season tickets and car sharing, a wide range of sports offered by the , and attractive* You can look forward to an exciting working environment, cultural diversity and attractive offers and benefits.* We value the diversity of our team and, to further enhance the diversity of our workforce, we particularly encourage women to apply.We value diversity and sustainability-------------------------------------In line with , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a .Curious? So are we.-------------------Please include the following documents with your application:* Motivation letter in pdf* CV in pdf* Relevant certificates and diplomas in pdf formatWe look forward to receiving your online application, including a letter of motivation, CV, diplomas, and employment certificates. Please address your application to Mrs Frequente, CSCS Human Resources, Via Trevano 131, 6900 Lugano.Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.Further information about CSCS can be found on our . Questions regarding the position should be directed to Pim Witlox, witlox@ (no applications).For recruitment services, the apply.About ETH Zürich-----------------ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities specialising in science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education, cutting\-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe, yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.![ETH Zürich]()* ETH Zürich  Culmannstrasse 8  8006 Zürich*jid7d6273ajm jit1147jm jiy26jm

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Collaborateur-trice scientifique---Collaborateur\-trice scientifique=================================Vous aimeriez contribuer au développement du canton de Fribourg, avez l'esprit du service public, et cherchez un poste varié qui fait sens ? A l'Etat de Fribourg vous travaillerez pour le plus grand employeur du canton. A l'écoute, dynamique et tournée vers l'avenir, l'administration cantonale, et ses établissements, sont au service de la population fribourgeoise.Collaborateur\-trice scientifique================================= **Qui sommes\-nous?**Enseignement, recherche, emplois, événements: l'Université de Fribourg est un espace d'innovations et un moteur important pour la vie économique et culturelle de la région. Elle attire des étudiant\-e\-s et des chercheur\-euse\-s en provenance de toute la Suisse et du monde entier, elle marque le quotidien de la cité bilingue de Fribourg, depuis sa fondation en 1889\.The Knowledge and Technology Transfer Service of the University of Fribourg supports researchers in industry collaborations, the protection and commercialization of research results, and the creation of spin\-offs. **Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**Nous misons sur la complémentarité des compétences et la variété des perspectives car c'est la diversité des parcours et des profils qui fait la force de l'Etat de Fribourg. title: Architekt:in / Projektleiter:in Planung
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Architekt:in / Projektleiter:in Planung (m/w/d)--- Architekt:in / Projektleiter:in Planung (m/w/d)===============================================Architekt:in / Projektleiter:in Planung (m/w/d)===============================================Die ETH Zürich startet mit dem «Living Lab HIL» ein pionierhaftes Forschungsprojekt mit direktem Bezug zur Baupraxis. Das HIL\-Gebäude auf dem Campus Hönggerberg wird zu einem Reallabor. Der sanierungsbedürftige Bau wird umgebaut und erweitert. In den kommenden Jahren erforschen und planen Professuren der Departemente Architektur (D\-ARCH) sowie Bau, Umwelt und Geomatik (D\-BAUG) die Sanierung des Gebäudes HIL im Sinne des zirkulären Bauens. Ziel ist es, das nachhaltige Entwerfen und im Bestand weiterzuentwickeln und exemplarisch an einem realen Planungs\- und Bauprojekt anzuwenden.Für das Planungsteam des Living Lab HIL suchen wir eine führungserfahrene und profilierte Persönlichkeit, die die strategische und operative Steuerung der gesamten Planungsphase übernimmt und die Gesamtprojektleitung unterstützt. In dieser zentralen Schlüsselfunktion steuern Sie die komplexen Prozesse mit dem Gesamtleister und stellen sicher, dass die Projektziele erfolgreich erreicht werden.Stellenbeschreibung-------------------In dieser projektbezogenen übernehmen Sie schwerpunktmässig folgende Aufgaben und Verantwortungen:* **Projektleitung Planung:** Gesamtverantwortung für die operative Steuerung, Überwachung und Koordination aller Planungsphasen des Bauprojekts Living Lab HIL.* **Gesamtleister\-Kommunikation:** Federführende Steuerung, Verhandlungsführung und strukturierter Austausch mit dem externen Gesamtleister und den Fachplanern.* **Schnittstellenmanagement:** Zentrale Koordination zwischen der ETH Real Estate, dem Gesamtleister, dem Team der Lehr\- und Forschungsintegration und dem Planungsteam.* **Mitwirkung Geschäftsführung:** Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung, Übernahme von operativen Führungsaufgaben und Vertretung der Projektinteressen in strategischen Gremien.* **Risiko\- \& Qualitätsmanagement:** Sicherstellung der übergeordneten Projektziele in Bezug auf Termine, Kosten, Nachhaltigkeitsvorgaben und Qualitäten im komplexen Kontext von Forschung und Baupraxis.* Die Stelle ist vorerst auf maximal fünf Jahre befristet, zunächst mit einem Einjahresvertrag mit Verlängerungsoptionen.Profil------Um die Anforderungen dieser anspruchsvollen Position ideal zu erfüllen, bringen Sie folgendes Profil mit:* **Ausbildung:** Abgeschlossenes Master\-Studium in Architektur (ETH/FH oder vergleichbar).* **Berufserfahrung:** Fundierte, langjährige Berufserfahrung in der Projektleitung und Gesamtsteuerung komplexer Grossbauprojekte in der Schweiz. Erfahrung mit im Bestand ist von Vorteil.* **GP\-Erfahrung:** Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der vertraglichen und operativen Führung von Gesamtleisterteams sowie in der anspruchsvollen, interdisziplinären Koordination.* **Mindset:** Ausgeprägtes strategisches und unternehmerisches Denken, gepaart mit einer pragmatischen, zielorientierten Umsetzungskompetenz.* **Leadership:** Erkennbares Führungspotenzial oder bereits nachgewiesene Erfahrung in einer geschäftsführenden bzw. leitenden Funktion.* **CAD\-Kenntnisse:** Sehr gute, praxiserprobte Kenntnisse in 3D\-CAD, vorzugsweise Rhino und BIM\-Systemen.* **Sprachen:** Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.Wir bieten----------* Abwechslungsreiche Projektbearbeitung an der Schnittstelle von Architektur, Forschung und Praxis.* Ihr Arbeitsort ist im neuen Projektbüro im HIL\-Gebäude auf dem ETH\-Campus Hönggerberg.* Ihre Position ist dem Projektteam im Departement Architektur angegliedert.* Wir bieten attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen in einem dynamischen, innovativen und internationalen Umfeld.* Sie arbeiten eigenverantwortlich und in ständigem kollegialem Austausch mit unserem Team sowie einer Vielfalt an Partner:innen und Anspruchsgruppen.Diversität und Nachhaltigkeit sind uns wichtig-----------------------------------------------Im Einklang mit unterstützt die ETH Zürich eine inklusive Kultur. Wir fördern Chancengleichheit, schätzen Vielfalt und pflegen ein Arbeits\- und Lernumfeld, in dem die Rechte und die Würde aller Mitarbeitenden und Studierenden respektiert werden. Auf unserer erfahren Sie, wie wir ein faires und offenes Umfeld sicherstellen, in dem sich alle entwickeln und entfalten können. Nachhaltigkeit ist für uns ein zentraler Wert – wir arbeiten konsequent an einerNeugierig? Sind wir auch.-------------------------Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online\-Bewerbung mit den folgenden Unterlagen:* Motivationsschreiben* Lebenslauf* Arbeitszeugnisse und QualifikationenWeitere Informationen über das Projekt finden Sie auf unserer . Für Auskünfte steht Ihnen , zueger@ (keine Bewerbungsunterlagen), gerne zur Verfügung.Bitte bewerben Sie sich ausschliesslich über das Online\-Bewerbungsportal. Bewerbungen per E\-Mail sowie auf dem Postweg werden nicht berücksichtigt.Gerne weisen wir darauf hin, dass die Vorselektion durch die verantwortlichen Rekrutierenden und nicht durch künstliche Intelligenz durchgeführt wird.Für Personalvermittlungen gelten die .Über die ETH Zürich---------------------Die ETH Zürich ist eine der besten technisch\-naturwissenschaftlichen Hochschulen der Welt. Wir sind bekannt für unsere exzellente Lehre, wegweisende Grundlagenforschung und den direkten Transfer von neuen Erkenntnissen in die Gesellschaft. Über 30'000 Menschen aus mehr als 120 Ländern finden bei uns ein Umfeld, das eigenständiges Denken fördert, und ein Klima, das zu Spitzenleistungen inspiriert. Im Herzen Europas und weltweit vernetzt entwickeln wir gemeinsam Lösungen für die globalen Herausforderungen von heute und morgen.![ETH Zürich]()* ETH Zürich  Culmannstrasse 8  8006 Zürich*jid001eae8jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Employé(e) polyvalent(e) de pressing H/F --- Employé(e) polyvalent(e) de pressing H/F ========================================= Employé(e) polyvalent(e) de pressing à 80 % -- CDI ----------------------------------------------------- \*\*5àsec -- Marin, Suisse (2074 Marin\\-Epagnier)\*\* ### Qui sommes\\-nous ? Depuis 1968, 5àsec est spécialisé dans l'entretien et le traitement des textiles. Notre priorité est d'offrir à nos clients un service de qualité grâce à notre savoir\\-faire et à notre expertise. \*\*Aucune expérience dans le pressing n'est nécessaire : une formation interne gratuite est assurée !\*\* ### Vos missions Le poste associe accueil et service client, ainsi que traitement technique des textiles. \*\*Accueil et relation client\*\* \* Accueillir les clients et réceptionner leurs vêtements. \* Les conseiller sur les prestations adaptées à leurs besoins. \* Assurer la remise des commandes. \* Veiller à la satisfaction des clients et à la qualité du service. \*\*Entretien et traitement des textiles\*\* \* Réaliser le détachage des vêtements. \* Effectuer les opérations de lavage et de séchage. \* Assurer le repassage et la préparation des articles. \* Contrôler la qualité des vêtements avant leur restitution aux clients. \* Respecter les procédures et les standards de qualité de l'entreprise. Vous travaillerez au sein d'un \*\*seul magasin situé à Marin\*\*, en collaboration avec l'équipe sur place. ### Les conditions du poste \* \*\*Contrat :\*\* CDI \* \*\*Taux d'activité :\*\* 80 % \* \*\*Temps de travail :\*\* environ 33,84 heures par semaine \* \*\*Rémunération :\*\* 3 060 CHF brut par mois \* \*\*Prime sur objectifs\*\* en complément du salaire fixe \* \*\*13e mois\*\* \* \*\*Lieu de travail :\*\* magasin 5àsec de Marin \* \*\*Organisation :\*\* travail sur plusieurs jours par semaine, selon le planning établi avec la gérante et la responsable de secteur. \* \*\*Repos :\*\* selon le planning communiqué par la hiérarchie. ### Les horaires L'amplitude horaire habituelle du magasin est de 8 h à 19 h. Les horaires sont organisés selon les besoins du magasin, avec une alternance entre les créneaux d'ouverture et de fermeture. \* \*\*Ouverture :\*\* de 8 h 30 à 17 h. \* \*\*Fermeture :\*\* de 10 h à 19 h. title: Projektleiter:in IT
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Projektleiter:in IT (m/w/d)--- Projektleiter:in IT (m/w/d)===========================Projektleiter:in IT (m/w/d)===========================An der ETH Zürich studieren über 20'000 Studierende auf Bachelor\- und Masterstufe oder sind als Hörer:innen eingeschrieben. Die Informatikdienste unterstützen Lehre, Forschung und Verwaltung mit Dienstleistungen im Bereich der Informations\- und Kommunikationstechnologien.Für das strategische Projekt «Digital Campus» suchen wir für einen befristeten Einsatz bis Ende 2028 eine engagierte und zuverlässige Persönlichkeit für die stellvertretende IT\-Projektleitung.Projekthintergrund------------------Im Projekt «Digital Campus» wird die bestehende Lehrbetriebslandschaft grundlegend erneuert. Mehr als 50 bestehende Applikationen sollen durch eine konfigurierbare Standardsoftware abgelöst werden, die in die ETH\-Systemlandschaft integriert und gezielt weiterentwickelt wird. Das Vorhaben verbindet fachliche Transformation, Systemintegration, Datenmigration und anspruchsvolle Architektur\- und Governance\-Fragestellungen.Stellenbeschreibung-------------------Du übernimmst eine zentrale in einem strategischen Grossprojekt und vertrittst die IT\-Projektleitung in definierten Führungs\-, Koordinations\- und Steuerungsaufgaben. Dabei stellst du die erfolgreiche Integration der neuen Lehrbetriebs\-Applikation in die ETH\-Systemlandschaft sicher und koordinierst die notwendigen Anpassungen unter Berücksichtigung aller relevanten Abhängigkeiten.Gemeinsam mit Business Engineers, Teilprojektleitenden, der Softwareanbieterin sowie Fach\- und IT\-Stellen arbeitest du an einer nachhaltigen und erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Du unterstützt die ICT\-Architektur bei der Definition des Zielbilds, bei technischen Entscheidungen sowie bei der Sicherstellung der Architekturkonformität. Zudem verantwortest du die Erstellung, Koordination und Qualitätssicherung der Compliance\-relevanten Unterlagen.Mit deinem Blick für effiziente Zusammenarbeit und klare Verantwortlichkeiten trägst du aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung der Projektmethodik und der Projektorganisation bei.Profil------* Fachlicher Background: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem verwandten Bereich.* Erfahrung: Du bringst nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer IT\-Projekte mit und kennst die besonderen Anforderungen von Grossprojekten.* Projektmanagement\-Expertise: Du bewegst dich sicher in klassischen, agilen und hybriden Vorgehensmodellen; praktische Erfahrung mit HERMES, Scrum und Kanban ist von Vorteil.* Zertifizierung: Eine anerkannte Projektmanagement\- oder Agile\-Zertifizierung (z. B. IPMA, PMI, HERMES, Scrum) ist von Vorteil, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung.* Technisches Know\-how: Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in IT\-Architekturen, Systemintegration, Softwareentwicklung, Datenmigration und Cyber Security.* Analytische Stärke: Du denkst strukturiert, analysierst komplexe Zusammenhänge zielsicher, entwickelst tragfähige Lösungen und triffst fundierte, nachvollziehbare Entscheide.* Kommunikationsgeschick: Du bringst technische Inhalte auf den Punkt – klar, verständlich und adressatengerecht für unterschiedliche Stakeholder.* Führungskompetenz \& Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst Verantwortung, bringst Beteiligte zusammen und handelst proaktiv.* Tool\-Sicherheit: Du bist mit gängigen Projektmanagement\- und Kollaborationstools wie Jira, Confluence und Microsoft 365 vertraut und setzt sie effizient ein.Wir bieten----------**Dein Beruf mit Wirkung**: Werde Teil der ETH Zürich, die nicht nur deine berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt, sondern auch aktiv zu positiven Veränderungen in der Gesellschaft beiträgt.Arbeiten im Vizepräsidium für Infrastruktur und Nachhaltigkeit (VPIN) bedeutet, die Zukunft der ETH Zürich aktiv mitzugestalten – eine inspirierende, internationale und innovative Institution. Dein Engagement schafft beste Voraussetzungen für Exzellenz in Lehre, Forschung, Wissenstransfer und Nachhaltigkeit der ETH Zürich.In einer offenen, inspirierenden Atmosphäre bilden Vertrauen, Verlässlichkeit und gegenseitiger Respekt das Fundament unserer Zusammenarbeit. Wir bieten nicht nur Sicherheit, sondern auch vielfältige Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Bei uns erwartet dich eine sinnstiftende Arbeit in einem innovativen und wertschätzenden Umfeld, das du mitgestalten kannst und dir neue Perspektiven eröffnet.* Flexible, gemeinsam gestaltbare Arbeitsmodelle und Möglichkeit für Homeoffice* Wir leben:* wie z.B. ÖV\-Abonnemente und Car Sharing, breites Sportangebot des , Kinderbetreuung etc.,Diversität und Nachhaltigkeit sind uns wichtig-----------------------------------------------Im Einklang mit unterstützt die ETH Zürich eine inklusive Kultur. Wir fördern Chancengleichheit, schätzen Vielfalt und pflegen ein Arbeits\- und Lernumfeld, in dem die Rechte und die Würde aller Mitarbeitenden und Studierenden respektiert werden. Auf unserer erfahren Sie, wie wir ein faires und offenes Umfeld sicherstellen, in dem sich alle entwickeln und entfalten können. Nachhaltigkeit ist für uns ein zentraler Wert – wir arbeiten konsequent an einerNeugierig? Sind wir auch.-------------------------Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online\-Bewerbung mit den folgenden Unterlagen:* Motivationsschreiben* Lebenslauf* Arbeitszeugnisse und DiplomeWeitere Informationen über Digital Campus findest Du auf unserer Webseite . Für Auskünfte steht Dir , @ (keine Bewerbungsunterlagen), gerne zur Verfügung.Bitte bewerbe Dich ausschliesslich über das Online\-Bewerbungsportal. Bewerbungen per E\-Mail sowie auf dem Postweg werden nicht berücksichtigt.Gerne weisen wir darauf hin, dass die Vorselektion durch die verantwortlichen Rekrutierenden und nicht durch künstliche Intelligenz durchgeführt wird.Für Personalvermittlungen gelten die .Über die ETH Zürich---------------------Die ETH Zürich ist eine der besten technisch\-naturwissenschaftlichen Hochschulen der Welt. Wir sind bekannt für unsere exzellente Lehre, wegweisende Grundlagenforschung und den direkten Transfer von neuen Erkenntnissen in die Gesellschaft. Über 30'000 Menschen aus mehr als 120 Ländern finden bei uns ein Umfeld, das eigenständiges Denken fördert, und ein Klima, das zu Spitzenleistungen inspiriert. Im Herzen Europas und weltweit vernetzt entwickeln wir gemeinsam Lösungen für die globalen Herausforderungen von heute und morgen.![ETH Zürich]()* ETH Zürich  Culmannstrasse 8  8006 Zürich*jid1d27606jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Hörsaalsupporter:in mit Anteil Abenddienst (m/w/d)--- Hörsaalsupporter:in mit Anteil Abenddienst (m/w/d)===================================================Hörsaalsupporter:in mit Anteil Abenddienst (m/w/d)===================================================Zur Unterstützung von Forschung und Lehre sind die Informatikdienste der ETH Zürich als Dienstleistungsorganisation in einer grossen und komplexen IT\-Umgebung tätig. Wir bieten den Angehörigen der ETH Zürich hochwertige, flexible und skalierbare Informatik\-Dienstleistungen an und unterstützen sie damit im Wettbewerb mit den besten Universitäten der Welt.Unsere Gruppe Multimedia Technologies ist zuständig für die AV\-technische Unterstützung der Lehre. Dafür entwickeln, realisieren und betreuen wir die notwendige Infrastruktur in den Hörsälen und Seminarräumen der ETH Zürich und betreiben die darauf aufbauenden Dienstleistungen.Projekthintergrund------------------**Per 1\.12\.2026 oder per Vereinbarung suchen wir zur Verstärkung unseres Teams eine:n Hörsaalsupporter:in mit Anteil Abenddienst (m/w/d).**Stellenbeschreibung-------------------Als Teil unseres Multimedia\-Supportteams arbeitest du am Standort Zürich Zentrum (Hochschulquartier) in einem engagierten und kollegialen Umfeld. Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere Audio\-Video\-Anlagen zuverlässig funktionieren und der Lehrbetrieb reibungslos läuft.Mit deiner Begeisterung für Multimediatechnik unterstützt du unsere Nutzenden im Alltag, hilfst bei technischen Fragen und findest gemeinsam im Team passende Lösungen. Du übernimmst Supportaufgaben, wirkst bei Unterhaltsarbeiten an den AV\-Installationen mit und bringst dich aktiv mit deinem Know\-how ein.Bei technischen Störungen bleibst du ruhig und gehst strukturiert vor. Du analysierst Probleme, behebst sie selbstständig oder stellst dem Lehrbetrieb innerhalb der vereinbarten Reaktionszeiten eine Ersatzlösung zur Verfügung.Neben dem Support pflegst du an unserem Multimedia\-Ausleihschalter engagiert Kontakt zu ETH\-Angehörigen und unterstützt bei einfachen Videokonferenzen.
