title: Senior Storage & Data Engineer
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Senior Storage &amp; Data Engineer--- Senior Storage \& Data Engineer===============================Senior Storage \& Data Engineer===============================**The Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS)** develops and operates a high\-performance computing and data research infrastructure that supports world\-class science in Switzerland. Its user laboratory is available to domestic and international researchers in academia, industry, and the business sector. The centre is operated by ETH Zurich and has offices at its data centre in Lugano and in Zurich.For this position the work location is either Lugano or Zürich. The contract is for two years.Project background------------------Storing petabytes is the easy part. The hard part is everything between the moment data lands on disk and the moment a researcher — or a training job — can actually trust it, find it, and use it.  Our parallel filesystems and object stores already move data fast. What they don't do on their own is tell a scientist where a dataset came from, which transformations produced it, whether it's the version that backed last quarter's published result, or how to feed it to a DataLoader without saturating the I/O subsystem. That gap — between raw bytes and usable, traceable, reproducible data — is where this role lives.  You'll work at both ends: the storage layer (throughput, integrity, tiering at multi\-petabyte scale) and the data layer above it (lineage, provenance, discoverability, access patterns). If you've ever been annoyed that *"the data is on the cluster"* gets treated as the end of the job rather than the start of it, read on.description-----------* **Bridge ingestion and use.** Design the pipelines and metadata that turn ingested data into something findable and consumable — catalogs, schemas, and access layers that match how training jobs and simulations actually read, not just where bytes sit.* **Make data traceable.** Build lineage and provenance so any dataset, checkpoint, or result can be traced back to its inputs and transformations. Reproducibility is a first\-class requirement here, not a retrofit.* **Tune for the workload.** Optimise parallel filesystems (Lustre, GPFS) and object storage for the concurrency, small\-file, and large\-checkpoint patterns of distributed GPU training and HPC simulation.* **Operate at scale, safely.** Design and run multi\-petabyte storage with the integrity and availability scientific work depends on — erasure coding, redundancy, hot\-to\-archival tiering.* **Automate everything.** Deploy and scale storage and data services as code. Snowflake infrastructure doesn't survive at this scale.* **Make it observable.** Instrument storage health, capacity trends, and pipeline performance so problems surface before users feel them.* **Translate.** Turn real access patterns from domain scientists and ML engineers into technical requirements — and push back when a request would quietly break something downstream.For a project in the weather and climate domain, aimed at understanding and mitigating the impact of climate change, an opening for **two years** is available.The initial two\-year contract could potentially be extended or even become permanent.Profile-------* A technical degree (CS, engineering) **or** equivalent experience that demonstrates the same depth.* Solid storage grounding: filesystems (block and object), performance tuning, redundancy (RAID, erasure coding).* , and comfort automating infrastructure (Ansible, Terraform, or similar).* A working understanding of how ML and scientific workloads consume data — billions of small files, large checkpoints, sharding — and why naive layouts fall over.* A point of view on data lineage, provenance, or reproducibility — and ideally tooling you've used to enforce it.**What helps you stand out*** Hands\-on parallel filesystems (Lustre, Spectrum Scale/GPFS) or distributed storage (Ceph, VAST).* Scientific data formats — HDF5, Zarr, Parquet — and opinions on when each earns its place.* Object storage (S3\) interfaced with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).* Orchestration (Kubernetes, Argo) and data\-movement tooling.* Data versioning / cataloguing (e.g. DVC, lakeFS, a metadata catalog) and familiarity with FAIR data principles.* CI/CD and provisioning: GitLab CI, HashiCorp Vault, MAAS.We don't expect every box ticked. Depth in storage *or* data engineering, plus the curiosity to grow into the other, matters more than a complete checklist.**What you get*** Hardware and scale you won't find in enterprise IT — and problems with no vendor playbook.* Work that directly enables published science and frontier\-scale model training.* Room to shape how data is *managed*, not just maintained, in an environment that takes it seriously.**Our core values as guiding principles:*** Curiosity: You enjoy learning and understanding systems deeply* Openness: You collaborate effectively and value different perspectives* Courage: You are willing to tackle difficult or unfamiliar problems* Supportive: You help colleagues and users succeed* Integrity: You act responsibly, reliably, and transparentlyWe offer--------We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive engineering team and particularly encourage applications from groups underrepresented in tech. If you are technically adept, curious, and eager to grow, we want to hear from you.* Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society* You can expect , such as public transport season tickets and car sharing, a wide range of sports offered by the , and attractive* You can look forward to an exciting working environment, cultural diversity and attractive offers and benefits.* We value the diversity of our team and, to further enhance the diversity of our workforce, we particularly encourage women to apply.We value diversity and sustainability-------------------------------------In line with , ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a .Curious? So are we.-------------------Please include the following documents with your application:* Motivation letter in pdf* CV in pdf* Relevant certificates and diplomas in pdf formatWe look forward to receiving your online application, including a letter of motivation, CV, diplomas, and employment certificates. Please address your application to Mrs Frequente, CSCS Human Resources, Via Trevano 131, 6900 Lugano.Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.Further information about CSCS can be found on our . Questions regarding the position should be directed to Pim Witlox, witlox@ (no applications).For recruitment services, the apply.About ETH Zürich-----------------ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities specialising in science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education, cutting\-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe, yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.![ETH Zürich]()* ETH Zürich  Culmannstrasse 8  8006 Zürich*jid7d6273ajm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: AI Architect 100%
description: # AI Architect**Location** · Zurich, Switzerland## About the RoleWe’re looking for an AI Architect to lead the technical strategy for AI across our products and internal systems. You’ll turn business priorities into architecture decisions and guide AI initiatives from use case definition through to production. Your focus will be on building secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions that teams can operate and maintain.You’ll work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, software architects, product leaders, and executives to set technical direction, explain trade-offs, and guide delivery.## Key Responsibilities### Architecture and strategy- Design end-to-end AI and ML architectures covering data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.- Define the enterprise AI roadmap, reference architectures, and technology standards.- Lead build-versus-buy assessments for foundation models, open-source models, and vendor platforms.### Cloud architecture- Design and lead the delivery of cloud-native AI solutions on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud using managed AI services and scalable infrastructure.- Define cloud landing zones, networking, identity and access management, and security patterns for AI workloads.- Develop hybrid or multi-cloud strategies where appropriate, taking data residency into account.- Optimize cloud cost and performance through FinOps practices, including GPU capacity planning and autoscaling.### Generative AI and large language models- Design applications that use large language models (LLMs), including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, tool integration, and fine-tuning.- Define evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring for model quality, safety, latency, and cost.- Evaluate model and retrieval performance against business use cases and establish standards for managing prompts, context, and models.### ML platforms and MLOps- Lead the design of scalable ML platforms, including feature stores, vector databases, model registries, CI/CD pipelines, and inference infrastructure.- Design production AI systems for reliability, scalability, and disaster recovery.### Governance, security, and responsible AI- Embed security, privacy, and responsible AI principles into solution design. Work with legal and compliance teams to address applicable requirements and assurance standards.- Define standards for bias testing, explainability, auditability, and data governance.- Partner with legal, security, and risk teams to develop and implement AI policies.### Technical leadership and collaboration- Align business stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors, and cloud providers on architecture decisions and delivery priorities.- Mentor ML engineers, data scientists, and software teams.- Explain AI capabilities, risks, and trade-offs to executives and non-technical stakeholders.- Produce and review technical documentation, architecture decision records, and presentations.- Lead architecture reviews, proofs of concept, and vendor evaluations.- Follow developments in AI research, tools, and industry practices to inform technology decisions.## Required Experience and Technical Skills- **8+ years in software or data engineering**, including **4+ years designing and delivering production AI or ML solutions**.- **5+ years of hands-on cloud experience**, with deep expertise in at least one major platform and its AI services, such as AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure AI and Azure OpenAI Service, or Google Cloud Vertex AI.- Proven experience designing cloud-native systems using serverless services, containers, Docker, Kubernetes, networking, identity and access management, and security best practices.- Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep, and with managing cloud costs.- Deep understanding of machine learning, deep learning, large language models, and generative AI techniques.- Hands-on Python experience with tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face libraries, and experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex.- Proven MLOps experience, including CI/CD, model monitoring, and workflow orchestration.- Strong knowledge of data architecture, including data lakes and warehouses, streaming, vector databases, and ETL/ELT pipelines.- Experience designing secure, scalable distributed systems and APIs.- Strong communication, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills.## Preferred Qualifications- Professional cloud certifications in architecture, AI, or machine learning from AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.- Experience designing hybrid or multi-cloud architectures and leading cloud migrations.- Experience building multi-agent systems and agentic AI architectures.- Familiarity with model adaptation and optimization techniques such as LoRA, RLHF, distillation, and quantization, and with inference tools such as vLLM or TensorRT.- Experience in regulated environments such as financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, or government.- Published research, patents, or open-source contributions.## Key Competencies- Systems thinking and sound architectural judgment.- Ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.- Practical judgment when balancing innovation, delivery, cost, and risk.- Ownership and sound decision-making when requirements are still evolving.- Ability to influence decisions without direct authority.- Commitment to ethical and responsible AI.

HR Business Partner
===================

**The company**

The Swatch Group Services Ltd. is a dynamic company of the Swatch Group providing high quality services to the Group organizations worldwide in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management Real Estate \& Gems. The company belongs to the Swatch Group, the world's largest watch maker with a portfolio of 16 brands of which Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak.

Swatch Group Services offers a unique ecosystem where people can accomplish their goals and achieve their aspirations. To strengthen our HR team, we are offering an exciting opportunity based between Biel (60%) and Neuchâtel (40%), with flexibility to discuss the allocation. We are currently looking for an:

**HR Business Partner (100%)**

**Job description**

In this role, you will manage the complete employee life cycle and support our managers as a coach and consultant, helping them guide their teams toward success. Your mission? Build a great work environment, solve challenges with style, and contribute to the vibrant culture of our company.

**Profile**

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Act as the main point of contact for employees and managers (\>150 employees)
* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment and staffing for The Swatch Group Services in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management, Real Estate as well as for the Group's companies based in Neuchâtel.
* Be a partner with managers to analyse needs and select top talent.
* Negotiate offers, prepare contracts, and ensure smooth onboarding \& offboarding.
* Provide guidance on employee relations, performance topics, and change initiatives.
* Support managers in handling discussions, resolving issues, and navigating team conflicts.
* Organise and control of the yearly evaluation and talent management process, and follow\-up with measures if needed.
* Follow up on development needs and action plans.
* Handle warnings and contract terminations.


At Swatch Group Services, we value fresh ideas, especially in areas like employer branding, employee retention \& HR process optimization, to keep improving our quality standards and elevating the employee experience.

**Professional requirements**

* University degree in HR or equivalent (Brevet fédéral) with over 5 years of experience in a similar role.
* You are a natural networker, collaborate efficiently with everybody and you build a trustful relationship at all levels and be regarded as a trusted partner.
* You get a strong experience in Recruitment ideally in the Supply Chain field. Hands on in sourcing.
* You have an excellent consultative and client service skill with the ability to effectively influence and manage key relationships with a strong knowledge of Swiss law.
* Autonomous and self\-motivated, with initiative and an ability to manage multiple priorities with a sense of urgency.
* You are data driven as well as highly organized: You have a very structured way of working, being able to prioritize a variety of complex tasks and to complete them diligently


**You're missing one or two skills in the list, yet you're eager to learn?  
It's perfectly OK. We like to share.**

**Languages**

Now, in order to blend in, socially and professionally, we certainly recommend the following languages:

* Fluent in French and in English, combined with good knowledge of German considered an asset.
* Any other languages are welcome \- we have 29 so far in the company, if you wish to add the 30th, you pretty much know what to do


**Company address**

**Contact**

A dynamic and evolving work environment, complemented by attractive benefits:

* Continuous training to support your professional development
* Career growth opportunities through our internal mobility policy
* 5 to 6 weeks of vacation per year, depending on your age and/or position
* A 40\-hour work week, in line with the collective labor agreement (CCT)
* Competitive salary and excellent social benefits
* Parental leave: up to 3 weeks for the other parent and 19 weeks for mothers
* On\-site company restaurant with employer financial contribution
* Exclusive discounts on Swatch Group products and with our partners
* Sports activities and internal events to foster team spirit
* Contribution to health insurance costs

Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.   Sunrise is transforming its Purchase\-to\-Pay (P2P) landscape through the P2P Optimisation Programme. A central pillar of this programme is the Sunrise Buying Desk – a two\-location, tiered support model designed to deliver consistent, expert P2P service across every business unit.As P2P Desk Manager, you lead the Zurich function. You are not a transaction processor – you are the operational authority who resolves what automated and first\-line support cannot, closes systemic gaps and raises the bar for P2P performance across Sunrise.  **YOUR CHALLENGE:*** **Own the Outcome**  Be the expert who resolves what standard process can't – across PR/PO queries, invoice issues, vendor cases and time\-critical escalations. Coordinate directly with Finance, Procurement and Business where needed, maintain full stakeholder visibility and close every case compliantly within SLA   * **Set the Quality Bar**  Validate purchase requisitions end\-to\-end – contract alignment, commodity classification, policy compliance, approval routing – and drive clean PO conversion. Apply the same rigour to vendor onboarding: validate the business case, ensure correct Ariba setup and direct all spend to the right buying channel, including SG\&A and Consultancy via Consulting Requisitions (ConReq)   * **Fix It for**  't just resolve today's issue, identify the pattern behind it. Translate recurring P2P problems into structured improvement initiatives that feed directly into the P2P Improvement Programme and make the process permanently better   * **Build Capability, Not Dependency**  Maintain accurate master data (pricing, catalogues, payment terms, commodity codes) as the foundation for friction\-free purchasing and invoice processing. Train and coach business units on the Spend Policy, so they do it right the first time, every time. catalogues, contracts and Purchase Orders to drive compliant buying behaviour at source   * **Measure What Matters**  Track operational KPIs (STIP – Straight\-Through\-Invoice\-Processing, Invoice compliance, Purchase Order compliance, Vendor onboarding time), report non\-compliance trends and flag Category Strategy deviations to the responsible Category Manager – turning data into accountability   **YOUR SKILLS:*** Minimum 5 years of hands\-on procurement or P2P operations experience in a mid\-to\-large enterprise, with a track record of managing complex, high\-volume transactional environments* Proficient in SAP S/4HANA; working knowledge of SAP Ariba (Buying, Sourcing or Contracts modules) is a strong advantage* Solid grasp of end\-to\-end P2P processes, purchase policy frameworks, escalation management and vendor onboarding – including the ability to distinguish what needs to be resolved vs. what needs to be redesigned* Analytical mindset: you read case data, identify patterns and translate operational KPIs into concrete improvement actions* Skilled communicator who can de\-escalate urgent situations, influence behaviour without formal authority and engage confidently with senior stakeholders* Professional procurement/ IT certification is an advantage* Fluent English and strong language skills, both written and spokenAt Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. title: Postdoc in Computational Systems Biology and Metabolic Modeling
description: Postdoc in Computational Systems Biology and Metabolic Modeling Postdoc in Computational Systems Biology and Metabolic Modeling===============================================================Dysregulation of lipid metabolism plays a key role in the development and progression of metabolic disorders, including obesity, type 2 diabetes, and metabolic dysfunction\-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist in Computational and Systems Biology to work on a project funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) aimed at advancing our understanding of human lipid metabolism in MASLD. The project focuses on modelling human metabolism by integrating clinical data with experimental models. It involves biochemical and molecular data from multiple tissues and biofluids to investigate tissue\-specific metabolism, metabolic interactions across organs, and nutrient uptake, transformation, and release. The project combines statistical modelling, systems biology, and in silico metabolic modelling with clinical, transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic/lipidomic, spatial molecular imaging, and experimental metabolic flux data to provide new insights into the complex metabolic alterations underlying MASLD.**What you can expect*** Develop and apply mathematical, statistical, and machine\-learning models to complex, high\-dimensional, and multimodal biological and clinical datasets, including spatial and imaging data* Model lipid and nutrient metabolism using compartmental, kinetic, mechanistic, metabolic network, or physiologically based approaches* Reconstruct and model tissue\-specific metabolic networks and validate model predictions using experimental data* Participate in and contribute to multidisciplinary and collaborative research projects.* Prepare, present, and communicate scientific findings at internal meetings, international conferences, and through peer\-reviewed publications**Your Profile*** PhD or equivalent in computational biology, systems biology, applied mathematics, biochemical engineering, or a related field* Strong expertise in mathematical and statistical modelling, machine learning, and systems biology, with experience analysing high\-dimensional, multimodal, or multi\-omics biological or clinical data* Demonstrated experience in in silico metabolic modelling, e.g. constraint\-based or genome\-scale metabolic modelling, metabolic network reconstruction, kinetic or metabolic flux modelling, or data\-driven simulation* Proficiency in R, , or MATLAB and experience integrating experimental data with computational models;* Experience in mass spectrometry, spatial omics, molecular imaging, or tissue imaging is a strong asset* Enthusiastic and collaborative scientist with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, the ability to work independently and in multidisciplinary teams, and excellent written and spoken English**What we offer*** A supportive, collaborative, and state\-of\-the\-art research environment with opportunities for scientific and professional development* Participation in multidisciplinary research projects at the interface of computational biology, systems biology, metabolism, multi\-omics, molecular imaging, and clinical research* The opportunity to work with large datasets from pre\-clinical and clinical studies* Close collaboration with experts from different scientific and clinical disciplines**Questions about the job?**For further information, please contact **Prof. Mojgan Masoodi** Head of ResearchINSELSPITAL  3010 Berne![INSELSPITAL]()jid409e4f3jm jit1148jm jiy26jm

HR Business Partner
===================

**The company**

The Swatch Group Services Ltd. is a dynamic company of the Swatch Group providing high quality services to the Group organizations worldwide in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management Real Estate \& Gems. The company belongs to the Swatch Group, the world's largest watch maker with a portfolio of 16 brands of which Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak.

Swatch Group Services offers a unique ecosystem where people can accomplish their goals and achieve their aspirations. To strengthen our HR team, we are offering an exciting opportunity based between Biel (60%) and Neuchâtel (40%), with flexibility to discuss the allocation. We are currently looking for an:

**HR Business Partner (100%)**

**Job description**

In this role, you will manage the complete employee life cycle and support our managers as a coach and consultant, helping them guide their teams toward success. Your mission? Build a great work environment, solve challenges with style, and contribute to the vibrant culture of our company.

**Profile**

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Act as the main point of contact for employees and managers (\>150 employees)
* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment and staffing for The Swatch Group Services in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management, Real Estate as well as for the Group's companies based in Neuchâtel.
* Be a partner with managers to analyse needs and select top talent.
* Negotiate offers, prepare contracts, and ensure smooth onboarding \& offboarding.
* Provide guidance on employee relations, performance topics, and change initiatives.
* Support managers in handling discussions, resolving issues, and navigating team conflicts.
* Organise and control of the yearly evaluation and talent management process, and follow\-up with measures if needed.
* Follow up on development needs and action plans.
* Handle warnings and contract terminations.


At Swatch Group Services, we value fresh ideas, especially in areas like employer branding, employee retention \& HR process optimization, to keep improving our quality standards and elevating the employee experience.

**Professional requirements**

* University degree in HR or equivalent (Brevet fédéral) with over 5 years of experience in a similar role.
* You are a natural networker, collaborate efficiently with everybody and you build a trustful relationship at all levels and be regarded as a trusted partner.
* You get a strong experience in Recruitment ideally in the Supply Chain field. Hands on in sourcing.
* You have an excellent consultative and client service skill with the ability to effectively influence and manage key relationships with a strong knowledge of Swiss law.
* Autonomous and self\-motivated, with initiative and an ability to manage multiple priorities with a sense of urgency.
* You are data driven as well as highly organized: You have a very structured way of working, being able to prioritize a variety of complex tasks and to complete them diligently


**You're missing one or two skills in the list, yet you're eager to learn?  
It's perfectly OK. We like to share.**

**Languages**

Now, in order to blend in, socially and professionally, we certainly recommend the following languages:

* Fluent in French and in English, combined with good knowledge of German considered an asset.
* Any other languages are welcome \- we have 29 so far in the company, if you wish to add the 30th, you pretty much know what to do


**Company address**

**Contact**

A dynamic and evolving work environment, complemented by attractive benefits:

* Continuous training to support your professional development
* Career growth opportunities through our internal mobility policy
* 5 to 6 weeks of vacation per year, depending on your age and/or position
* A 40\-hour work week, in line with the collective labor agreement (CCT)
* Competitive salary and excellent social benefits
* Parental leave: up to 3 weeks for the other parent and 19 weeks for mothers
* On\-site company restaurant with employer financial contribution
* Exclusive discounts on Swatch Group products and with our partners
* Sports activities and internal events to foster team spirit
* Contribution to health insurance costs
